```tsx
  return <CodeInput aria-label="Filter" language="sql" defaultValue="status = 'active' and created_at > now() - interval '1 day'" />;
}

/**
 * A results filter that applies on Enter, a JSON column value in a Field with an error, and the
 * read-only pretty viewer for a cell value.
 */
export function CodeInputRealistic() {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("region = 'emea'");
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState(filter);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState('{"retries": 3, "timeout": }');
  let settingsError: string | undefined;
  try {
    JSON.parse(settings);
  } catch {
    settingsError = "Not valid JSON: a value is missing after \"timeout\".";
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-stack-md">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Filter rows</FieldLabel>
        <CodeInput language="sql" size="sm" value={filter} onValueChange={setFilter} onSubmit={setApplied} placeholder="A SQL condition, then Enter" />
        <FieldDescription>Applied: {applied || "nothing"}</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field invalid={settingsError !== undefined}>
        <FieldLabel>Connection settings</FieldLabel>
        <CodeInput language="json" multiline rows={2} value={settings} onValueChange={setSettings} />
        <FieldError match={settingsError !== undefined}>{settingsError}</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <CodeInput aria-label="Cell value" language="json" pretty value={'{"id":42,"tags":["new","vip"],"address":{"city":"Hanoi","zip":null},"active":true}'} />
      <CodeInput aria-label="Disabled filter" disabled defaultValue="id = 1" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Collapsible

[collapsible.json](collapsible.json): One section that shows and hides its panel: a quiet text trigger with a turning chevron and a panel that fades in.

Usage: Use Collapsible for one optional block of detail under something else: server notices under a result, advanced connection options, a query plan. Compose Collapsible > CollapsibleTrigger + CollapsiblePanel; control it with open and onOpenChange or start it with defaultOpen. For a list of sections of which one or several open, use Accordion; for detail that only matters on hover, use HoverCard.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/collapsible
- Parts: CollapsibleTrigger (data-slot collapsible-trigger): The button that opens and closes the panel; chevron={false} drops the chevron.; CollapsiblePanel (data-slot collapsible-panel): The content shown while open; keepMounted keeps it in the DOM while closed.
- Props: open (boolean); defaultOpen (boolean, default false); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); disabled (boolean, default false); children (ReactNode); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: open (data-panel-open), hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled), entering (data-starting-style), leaving (data-ending-style)
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.ring, color.ring-inner, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight
- Accessibility: The trigger is a <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls naming the panel; Enter and Space toggle it. The panel is removed from the DOM (or hidden with keepMounted) while closed, so its content is not read or reached by Tab. The chevron is aria-hidden; the open state is announced through aria-expanded, not the icon. Only opacity changes while opening, and the chevron's turn stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

Examples (CollapsibleMinimal, CollapsibleRealistic):

```tsx
import { Collapsible, CollapsiblePanel, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/ui/collapsible";

/** The smallest useful Collapsible: a trigger and a panel. */
export function CollapsibleMinimal() {
  return (
    <Collapsible>
      <CollapsibleTrigger>Show details</CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsiblePanel>
        <p className="p-inset-xs text-body text-fg">Connected through the Plugin Host broker.</p>
      </CollapsiblePanel>
    </Collapsible>
  );
}

const notices = [
  'NOTICE: table "orders_tmp" does not exist, skipping',
  'NOTICE: relation "orders_status_idx" already exists, skipping',
  "WARNING: there is no transaction in progress",
];

/** Server notices under a query result, open; a disabled section; a long label that wraps. */
export function CollapsibleRealistic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-panel-md flex-col gap-stack-sm">
      <Collapsible defaultOpen>
        <CollapsibleTrigger>3 notices</CollapsibleTrigger>
        <CollapsiblePanel>
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-stack-xs rounded-md bg-inset p-inset-sm font-mono text-code text-fg">
            {notices.map((notice) => (
              <li key={notice}>{notice}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </CollapsiblePanel>
      </Collapsible>
      <Collapsible disabled>
        <CollapsibleTrigger>Query plan (run EXPLAIN first)</CollapsibleTrigger>
        <CollapsiblePanel>Plan</CollapsiblePanel>
      </Collapsible>
      <Collapsible>
        <CollapsibleTrigger>Statement 2 of 2: insert into analytics.events_partitioned_by_day_with_a_very_long_name select * from staging.events</CollapsibleTrigger>
        <CollapsiblePanel>
          <p className="p-inset-xs text-body text-fg">1,204 rows inserted.</p>
        </CollapsiblePanel>
      </Collapsible>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Combobox

[combobox.json](combobox.json): One choice from a long list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox: an input in an Input-like frame with clear and open buttons, and a popup of filtered items, groups, a no-results line and a status line, in three sizes.

Usage: Use Combobox when the user picks one value from a list too long to scan (tables, roles, time zones) or knows what to type. Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items (strings, { value, label } objects, groups of { value, items }, or a Combobox.createItems collection to store ids) and a function child that renders each item as a ComboboxItem; Base UI filters by label as the user types and the first match is highlighted, so Enter takes it. Show loading or an error of an async search with status, and say what was searched for with emptyMessage. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field. For a short fixed list use Select; for several values, MultiSelect; for free text with suggestions, an Input. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/combobox
- Parts: ComboboxItem (data-slot combobox-item): One item, role="option": its content, and a check mark while chosen; color.interactive.hover while highlighted.; ComboboxGroup (data-slot combobox-group): A group of items, role="group", named by its ComboboxGroupLabel; render its items in a ComboboxCollection.; ComboboxGroupLabel (data-slot combobox-group-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; ComboboxSeparator (data-slot combobox-separator): A 1 px line in color.border.default between items or groups.
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: items (Item[] | { value, items: Item[] }[] | ComboboxItemCollection); value (Value | null); defaultValue (Value | null); onValueChange ((value: Value | null, details) => void); inputValue (string); filter ((item, query) => boolean | null); placeholder (string); emptyMessage (ReactNode, default "\"No results.\""); status (ReactNode); autoHighlight (boolean, default true); appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); clearLabel (string, default "\"Clear\""); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (has-[input:focus-visible]), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), hover (hover), highlighted (data-highlighted), no value (not-data-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.inner-width, ring.width, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.md, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.md, space.inset.xs, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded and aria-controls, named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" of role="option" items with aria-selected, in role="group"s named by their labels. Typing filters and opens the list; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight while focus stays in the input (aria-activedescendant), Enter chooses, Escape closes and then clears, and Tab leaves. The chevron button is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology, as the input already opens the list; the clear button is reachable by pointer and is named by clearLabel. The status line is aria-live="polite", so loading and errors of an async search are announced without moving focus; the no-results line is announced the same way. The chosen item shows a check mark, so the state does not rest on colour; the frame's bottom edge is color.border.control-bottom (3:1 on every fill and surface). The popup takes the frame's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>.

Examples (ComboboxMinimal, ComboboxRealistic):

```tsx
import { Combobox, ComboboxCollection, ComboboxGroup, ComboboxGroupLabel, ComboboxItem, ComboboxSeparator } from "@/components/ui/combobox";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";

const schemas = ["public", "analytics", "audit", "billing", "inventory", "staging"];

/** The smallest useful Combobox: a labelled list of strings, filtered as you type. */
export function ComboboxMinimal() {
  return (
    <Field className="w-full">
      <FieldLabel>Schema</FieldLabel>
      <Combobox items={schemas} defaultValue="public" placeholder="Search schemas">
        {(schema: string) => (
          <ComboboxItem key={schema} value={schema}>
            {schema}
          </ComboboxItem>
        )}
      </Combobox>
    </Field>
  );
}

interface Table {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

const tables: { value: string; items: Table[] }[] = [
  {
    value: "public",
    items: [
      { value: "public.customers", label: "customers" },
      { value: "public.orders", label: "orders" },
      { value: "public.order_items", label: "order_items" },
    ],
  },
  {
    value: "audit",
    items: [
      { value: "audit.events", label: "events" },
      { value: "audit.sessions", label: "sessions" },
    ],
  },
];

const roles = ["dbee_reader", "dbee_writer", "dbee_admin"];

/**
 * Query targets: tables grouped by schema with a separator, a role that is still loading from the
 * server (status line), a time zone nobody has chosen (invalid), a database the connection fixes,
 * and the small and large sizes.
 */
export function ComboboxRealistic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-stack-md">
      <Field name="table">
        <FieldLabel>Table</FieldLabel>
        <Combobox items={tables} defaultValue={tables[0]!.items[1]!} placeholder="Search tables" emptyMessage="No table matches.">
          {(group: (typeof tables)[number], index: number) => (
            <ComboboxGroup key={group.value} items={group.items}>
              {index > 0 && <ComboboxSeparator />}
              <ComboboxGroupLabel>{group.value}</ComboboxGroupLabel>
              <ComboboxCollection>
                {(table: Table) => (
                  <ComboboxItem key={table.value} value={table}>
                    {table.label}
                  </ComboboxItem>
                )}
              </ComboboxCollection>
            </ComboboxGroup>
          )}
        </Combobox>
        <FieldDescription>Only tables this connection can read are listed.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="role">
        <FieldLabel>Run as role</FieldLabel>
        <Combobox items={roles} placeholder="Search roles" status="Loading roles…" size="small" appearance="filled-darker">
          {(role: string) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={role} value={role}>
              {role}
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </Combobox>
      </Field>
      <Field name="timezone" invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Session time zone</FieldLabel>
        <Combobox items={["UTC", "Europe/Berlin", "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh"]} placeholder="Search time zones">
          {(zone: string) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={zone} value={zone}>
              {zone}
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </Combobox>
        <FieldError>Choose the time zone timestamps are shown in.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field name="database" disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Database</FieldLabel>
        <Combobox items={["warehouse"]} defaultValue="warehouse">
          {(name: string) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={name} value={name}>
              {name}
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </Combobox>
        <FieldDescription>Fixed by the connection.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="search-path">
        <FieldLabel>Search path</FieldLabel>
        <Combobox items={schemas} defaultValue="analytics" size="large" appearance="underline">
          {(schema: string) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={schema} value={schema}>
              {schema}
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </Combobox>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### CommandPalette

[command-palette.json](command-palette.json): The searchable list of every action, on Base UI's Dialog and an inline Autocomplete: a search field over grouped commands with icons and shortcuts, filtered in the page by label and keywords, opened by a hotkey; no network.

Usage: Use CommandPalette as the one place where every action of the app can be found and run from the keyboard, with its shortcut shown: DBee's Ctrl+K / Ctrl+Shift+P. Pass groups of commands ({ id, label, shortcut, keywords, icon, disabled, onSelect }), control open with open and onOpenChange (and a button with aria-haspopup="dialog" for pointer users), and give hotkeys ("Mod+K": Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere) to toggle it anywhere. The palette closes before onSelect runs, so a command may open a dialog. Keep the list in sync with the app's shortcuts; for a few actions behind a button use DropdownMenu; for picking a value in a form, Combobox.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/autocomplete
- Parts: CommandPaletteItem (data-slot command-palette-item): One command's row, role="option": icon, label and shortcut (<kbd>), DropdownMenu's item look; CommandPalette renders one per command.
- Props: groups ({ label: string; items: Command[] }[]); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean) => void); hotkeys (string[]); placeholder (string, default "Type a command"); emptyText (ReactNode, default "No matching commands"); title (string, default "Command palette"); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.scrim, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.hover, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.dialog.shadow, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.gentle, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, radius.lg, radius.md, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.panel.lg, size.panel.sm, space.inline.lg, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.md, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.modal, z.overlay
- Accessibility: The palette is a modal role="dialog" named by a visually hidden title; focus goes to the search field (role="combobox") which controls a role="listbox" of role="option" commands in role="group"s named by their headings. Typing filters by label, keywords and group and highlights the first match; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight (aria-activedescendant) while focus stays in the field; Enter runs the highlighted command; Escape closes and focus returns to where it was. The hotkeys toggle the palette from anywhere; every command shows its own shortcut, so the palette also teaches them. Disabled commands are shown, so the user learns they exist, but cannot run. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns Dialog's transitions off. The palette takes the theme and density of the region where it is placed.

Examples (CommandPaletteMinimal, CommandPaletteRealistic):

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { CommandPalette, type CommandGroup } from "@/components/ui/command-palette";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { Table } from "@/lib/icons";
import { Kbd } from "@/components/ui/kbd";

const noop = () => {};

/** The smallest useful CommandPalette: a button (and Ctrl+K) opening a few commands. */
export function CommandPaletteMinimal() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const groups: CommandGroup[] = [
    {
      label: "Query",
      items: [
        { id: "run", label: "Run statement", shortcut: "Ctrl+Enter", onSelect: noop },
        { id: "new-tab", label: "New query tab", shortcut: "Ctrl+T", onSelect: noop },
      ],
    },
  ];
  return (
    <>
      <Button appearance="secondary" aria-haspopup="dialog" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Commands <Kbd>Ctrl+K</Kbd>
      </Button>
      <CommandPalette groups={groups} open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} hotkeys={["Mod+K"]} />
    </>
  );
}

/** DBee's palette: every action with its binding, in groups, with keywords and an action that needs a connection. */
export function CommandPaletteRealistic() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [last, setLast] = useState("nothing yet");
  const run = (label: string) => () => setLast(label);
  const groups: CommandGroup[] = [
    {
      label: "Query",
      items: [
        { id: "run", label: "Run statement", shortcut: "Ctrl+Enter", keywords: ["execute"], onSelect: run("Run statement") },
        { id: "cancel", label: "Cancel running statement", shortcut: "Shift+Escape", disabled: true, onSelect: run("Cancel") },
        { id: "export", label: "Export result", shortcut: "Ctrl+Shift+S", keywords: ["csv", "json", "download"], onSelect: run("Export result") },
        { id: "new-tab", label: "New query tab", shortcut: "Alt+Shift+T", keywords: ["open"], onSelect: run("New query tab") },
      ],
    },
    {
      label: "Connections",
      items: [
        { id: "add", label: "Add connection", shortcut: "Ctrl+Alt+N", onSelect: run("Add connection") },
        { id: "open-orders", label: "Open public.orders", icon: <Icon icon={Table} />, keywords: ["table"], onSelect: run("Open public.orders") },
      ],
    },
    {
      label: "View",
      items: [
        { id: "sidebar", label: "Toggle sidebar", shortcut: "Ctrl+B", onSelect: run("Toggle sidebar") },
        { id: "settings", label: "Settings", shortcut: "Ctrl+,", keywords: ["preferences", "theme", "density"], onSelect: run("Settings") },
      ],
    },
  ];
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-inline-md">
      <Button aria-haspopup="dialog" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Open command palette
      </Button>
      <span className="text-body-1 text-fg-muted">Last command: {last}</span>
      <CommandPalette groups={groups} open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} hotkeys={["Mod+Shift+P"]} placeholder="Type a command or a table" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### ContextMenu

[context-menu.json](context-menu.json): A menu opened by a right-click or the context-menu key on an area, on Base UI's ContextMenu: DropdownMenu's items (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus) at the pointer, on elevation.flyout (color.bg.overlay) at z.popover.

Usage: Use ContextMenu for the actions of the thing under the pointer: a tree node, a grid cell, a tab. Compose it as ContextMenu > ContextMenuTrigger (the area; give it its own classes) + ContextMenuContent > ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuRadioGroup with ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuGroup with ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, and ContextMenuSub > ContextMenuSubTrigger + ContextMenuSubContent. A right-click is not discoverable and not available to everyone: every action in it must also be reachable another way (a toolbar, a DropdownMenu, the CommandPalette, a shortcut). For a menu behind a visible button use DropdownMenu.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/context-menu
- Parts: ContextMenuTrigger (data-slot context-menu-trigger): The area that opens the menu on right-click or the context-menu key; a <div>, unstyled.; ContextMenuContent (data-slot context-menu-content): The portal, the positioner at the pointer and the menu.; ContextMenuItem (data-slot context-menu-item): role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.; ContextMenuCheckboxItem (data-slot context-menu-checkbox-item): role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.; ContextMenuRadioGroup (data-slot context-menu-radio-group): role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.; ContextMenuRadioItem (data-slot context-menu-radio-item): role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.; ContextMenuGroup (data-slot context-menu-group): role="group", named by its ContextMenuLabel.; ContextMenuLabel (data-slot context-menu-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; ContextMenuSeparator (data-slot context-menu-separator): role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.; ContextMenuShortcut (data-slot context-menu-shortcut): The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; ContextMenuSubTrigger (data-slot context-menu-sub-trigger): An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.; ContextMenuSubContent (data-slot context-menu-sub-content): The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean, default true); danger (boolean, default false); closeOnClick (boolean, default true); disabled (boolean, default false); checked (boolean); value (unknown); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), submenu-open (data-popup-open), danger (data-danger), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.overlay, color.border.strong, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.hover, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, radius.lg, radius.md, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.lg, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.md, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The popup is role="menu" of role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" and "menuitemradio" items with aria-checked; groups are role="group" named by their label. A right-click opens the menu at the pointer; on a focused area the context-menu key or Shift+F10 opens it (the browser sends the same contextmenu event). Focus moves into the menu; arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and returns focus. ArrowRight on a sub-trigger opens its submenu, ArrowLeft closes it. Disabled items stay reachable but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen. Every action in a context menu is also available elsewhere (toolbar, DropdownMenu, CommandPalette, shortcut), because right-click is not discoverable. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the slide and fade transitions off. The menu takes the area's theme and density and sits at z.popover.

Examples (ContextMenuMinimal, ContextMenuRealistic):

```tsx
import {
  ContextMenu,
  ContextMenuCheckboxItem,
  ContextMenuContent,
  ContextMenuGroup,
  ContextMenuItem,
  ContextMenuLabel,
  ContextMenuRadioGroup,
  ContextMenuRadioItem,
  ContextMenuSeparator,
  ContextMenuShortcut,
  ContextMenuSub,
  ContextMenuSubContent,
  ContextMenuSubTrigger,
  ContextMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/context-menu";

const area = "flex min-h-control-lg w-full items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed border-border-strong px-inset-md text-body text-fg-muted";

/** The smallest useful ContextMenu: right-click an area for its actions. */
export function ContextMenuMinimal() {
  return (
    <ContextMenu>
      <ContextMenuTrigger className={area}>Right-click the table “orders”</ContextMenuTrigger>
      <ContextMenuContent>
        <ContextMenuItem>Open query tab</ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem>Copy name</ContextMenuItem>
      </ContextMenuContent>
    </ContextMenu>
  );
}

/**
 * A connection node in the schema tree: the actions with shortcuts, a "Copy" submenu, the tree's
 * view options as checkbox and radio items, a disabled action and a destructive one.
 */
export function ContextMenuRealistic() {
  return (
    <ContextMenu>
      <ContextMenuTrigger className={area}>Right-click the connection “orders-prod”</ContextMenuTrigger>
      <ContextMenuContent>
        <ContextMenuGroup>
          <ContextMenuLabel>orders-prod</ContextMenuLabel>
          <ContextMenuItem>
            Connect
            <ContextMenuShortcut>Enter</ContextMenuShortcut>
          </ContextMenuItem>
          <ContextMenuItem disabled>
            Disconnect
            <ContextMenuShortcut>Ctrl+Shift+D</ContextMenuShortcut>
          </ContextMenuItem>
          <ContextMenuItem>
            Open query tab
            <ContextMenuShortcut>Ctrl+T</ContextMenuShortcut>
          </ContextMenuItem>
          <ContextMenuItem>
            Refresh
            <ContextMenuShortcut>F5</ContextMenuShortcut>
          </ContextMenuItem>
        </ContextMenuGroup>
        <ContextMenuSub>
          <ContextMenuSubTrigger>Copy</ContextMenuSubTrigger>
          <ContextMenuSubContent>
            <ContextMenuItem>Connection id</ContextMenuItem>
            <ContextMenuItem>Host and port</ContextMenuItem>
          </ContextMenuSubContent>
        </ContextMenuSub>
        <ContextMenuSeparator />
        <ContextMenuCheckboxItem defaultChecked>Show system schemas</ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
        <ContextMenuRadioGroup defaultValue="name">
          <ContextMenuRadioItem value="name">Sort by name</ContextMenuRadioItem>
          <ContextMenuRadioItem value="size">Sort by size</ContextMenuRadioItem>
        </ContextMenuRadioGroup>
        <ContextMenuSeparator />
        <ContextMenuItem>Edit…</ContextMenuItem>
        <ContextMenuItem danger>Delete…</ContextMenuItem>
      </ContextMenuContent>
    </ContextMenu>
  );
}
```

### DatePicker

[date-picker.json](date-picker.json): A date or a range of dates, typed into a text field (read with date-fns in a format, yyyy-MM-dd by default) or picked from a Calendar in a popup, on InputGroup and Base UI's Popover, in three sizes.

Usage: Use DatePicker for a day in a form or a filter (a restore point, a snapshot date), and mode="range" for a window of days (query history, an audit period). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel: the text field takes the label, description and validity. The value is a local Date at midnight (range: { from, to }, both ends), or null when empty or when the text is not a date in format; with TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field, and validate null as missing. Limit the days with min, max and disabledDays (react-day-picker matchers, such as { dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }). Pass a date-fns locale for the calendar's language and first weekday; keep format unambiguous (yyyy-MM-dd, or dd/MM/yyyy where the locale reads it). For a time of day use TimePicker beside it; for a calendar that stays visible, Calendar. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/popover
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: mode ("single" | "range", default "single"); value (Date | { from: Date; to: Date } | null); defaultValue (Date | { from: Date; to: Date } | null); onValueChange ((value) => void); format (string, default "yyyy-MM-dd"); locale (Locale (date-fns)); min (Date); max (Date); disabledDays (Matcher | Matcher[]); weekStartsOn (0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6); numberOfMonths (number, default "1 (2 for a range)"); appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); placeholder (string); calendarLabel (string, default "Choose date"); open (boolean); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), invalid (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][aria-invalid=true]]), selected (data-selected), disabled (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.compound, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.xl, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xl, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The text field is named by its FieldLabel (or aria-label), described by FieldDescription and FieldError, and aria-invalid while its text is not a date; the placeholder shows the format to type. The calendar button is named by calendarLabel ("Choose date") and has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; Alt+ArrowDown in the text field opens the calendar too. When the popup opens, focus moves to the chosen day (else today); the arrow keys, PageUp and PageDown move it, Enter or Space picks it, and the popup closes and returns focus to the text field. Escape closes it without a change. The calendar is a role="grid" per month with full-date labels on the days; days outside min, max or disabledDays are disabled and struck through. Everything the popup does can be done by typing the date, so the field also works without a pointer or the popup.

Examples (DatePickerMinimal, DatePickerRealistic):

```tsx
import { addDays, startOfDay } from "date-fns";
import { DatePicker } from "@/components/ui/date-picker";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";

/** The smallest useful DatePicker: a labelled day, typed or picked. */
export function DatePickerMinimal() {
  return (
    <Field className="w-full">
      <FieldLabel>Restore to</FieldLabel>
      <DatePicker defaultValue={startOfDay(new Date())} />
    </Field>
  );
}

/**
 * A query-history filter: a range over the last thirty days, a snapshot date with weekends
 * closed and nothing chosen yet (invalid), a retention date the policy fixes, and the small size.
 */
export function DatePickerRealistic() {
  const today = startOfDay(new Date());
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-stack-md">
      <Field name="history">
        <FieldLabel>Query history</FieldLabel>
        <DatePicker mode="range" defaultValue={{ from: addDays(today, -6), to: today }} min={addDays(today, -30)} max={today} />
        <FieldDescription>Up to thirty days back, as yyyy-MM-dd – yyyy-MM-dd.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="snapshot" invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Snapshot date</FieldLabel>
        <DatePicker disabledDays={{ dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }} weekStartsOn={1} />
        <FieldError>Choose a weekday for the snapshot.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field name="retention" disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Keep backups until</FieldLabel>
        <DatePicker defaultValue={addDays(today, 90)} />
        <FieldDescription>Set by the workspace administrator.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="since">
        <FieldLabel>Changed since</FieldLabel>
        <DatePicker size="small" appearance="filled-darker" format="dd/MM/yyyy" max={today} />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### DescriptionList

[description-list.json](description-list.json): Term/value pairs in a <dl>: the term beside its value or above it, optionally divided by rules; long values wrap.

Usage: Use DescriptionList for the facts of one thing: the grant summary in the approval dialog, a connection's details, About and diagnostics. Compose DescriptionList > DescriptionListItem > DescriptionListTerm + DescriptionListDetails (one or more). layout="stacked" in narrow panels; divided adds rules between items. For many records with the same fields use Table; for a single number use Stat.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Parts: DescriptionListItem (data-slot description-list-item): Groups one term with its values.; DescriptionListTerm (data-slot description-list-term): The term, a <dt>.; DescriptionListDetails (data-slot description-list-details): The value, a <dd>.
- layout: inline, stacked, aligned
- Props: layout ("inline" | "stacked" | "aligned", default "inline"); divided (boolean, default false); children (ReactNode); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDListElement>)
- States: divided (data-divided)
- Tokens: color.border.muted, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, font.mono, font.sans, size.panel.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.md, space.inline.xl, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight
- Accessibility: A real <dl> with <dt> and <dd> (each pair in a <div>, which HTML allows), so screen readers announce the list and pair terms with values. Terms are color.fg.muted and values color.fg.default, both contrast-checked as text. Long values (digests, paths) wrap instead of overflowing; not focusable.

Examples (DescriptionListMinimal, DescriptionListRealistic):

```tsx
import { DescriptionListDetails, DescriptionListItem, DescriptionList, DescriptionListTerm } from "@/components/ui/description-list";

/** The smallest useful DescriptionList: two pairs. */
export function DescriptionListMinimal() {
  return (
    <DescriptionList className="max-w-panel-md">
      <DescriptionListItem>
        <DescriptionListTerm>Host</DescriptionListTerm>
        <DescriptionListDetails>db.internal:5432</DescriptionListDetails>
      </DescriptionListItem>
      <DescriptionListItem>
        <DescriptionListTerm>Database</DescriptionListTerm>
        <DescriptionListDetails>orders</DescriptionListDetails>
      </DescriptionListItem>
    </DescriptionList>
  );
}

/** The approval dialog's grant summary (divided, a long digest that wraps) and About in a narrow panel (stacked). */
export function DescriptionListRealistic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-gap-xl">
      <DescriptionList divided className="w-panel-md">
        <DescriptionListItem>
          <DescriptionListTerm>Plugin</DescriptionListTerm>
          <DescriptionListDetails>db-driver-postgres 0.1.0 (first-party)</DescriptionListDetails>
        </DescriptionListItem>
        <DescriptionListItem>
          <DescriptionListTerm>May reach</DescriptionListTerm>
          <DescriptionListDetails>db.internal:5432 over TLS</DescriptionListDetails>
        </DescriptionListItem>
        <DescriptionListItem>
          <DescriptionListTerm>Access</DescriptionListTerm>
          <DescriptionListDetails>Read-only, expires in 1 hour</DescriptionListDetails>
        </DescriptionListItem>
        <DescriptionListItem>
          <DescriptionListTerm>Digest</DescriptionListTerm>
          <DescriptionListDetails className="font-mono text-code">sha256:9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08</DescriptionListDetails>
        </DescriptionListItem>
      </DescriptionList>
      <DescriptionList layout="stacked" className="w-panel-xs">
        <DescriptionListItem>
          <DescriptionListTerm>Version</DescriptionListTerm>
          <DescriptionListDetails>DBee 0.1.0</DescriptionListDetails>
        </DescriptionListItem>
        <DescriptionListItem>
          <DescriptionListTerm>Workspace</DescriptionListTerm>
          <DescriptionListDetails>/home/analyst/.local/share/dbee/workspaces/default</DescriptionListDetails>
        </DescriptionListItem>
      </DescriptionList>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Dialog

[dialog.json](dialog.json): A modal dialog on Base UI's Dialog: a trigger, a scrim, a centred popup in four widths with a title, a description, a scrolling body, a footer of actions and a close button.

Usage: Use Dialog for a short task the user must finish or cancel before going on, on top of the page: export settings, rename, keyboard shortcuts, About. Compose it as Dialog > DialogTrigger (render a Button) + DialogContent > DialogHeader (DialogTitle, DialogDescription), DialogBody, DialogFooter (DialogClose rendering a Button, then the primary action last). Every dialog needs a DialogTitle; open it without a trigger through open and onOpenChange (from a menu item or a shortcut). For a decision that must not be dismissed by a click outside (delete, destructive SQL, approve access) use AlertDialog; for a form that edits something beside the page (a connection) use Sheet; for a small, non-modal panel attached to a control use Popover.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/dialog
- Parts: DialogTrigger (data-slot dialog-trigger): Opens the dialog; unstyled, render a Button through render. aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.; DialogContent (data-slot dialog-content): The portal with the scrim, the viewport and the popup, plus a close IconButton unless showClose is false.; DialogBackdrop (data-slot dialog-backdrop): The scrim; DialogContent renders it.; DialogViewport (data-slot dialog-viewport): The centring layer; DialogContent renders it.; DialogHeader (data-slot dialog-header): The title and description, stacked, leaving room for the close button.; DialogTitle (data-slot dialog-title): An <h2> in text.subtitle-1 (Fluent's dialog title) that names the dialog (aria-labelledby).; DialogDescription (data-slot dialog-description): A <p> in color.fg.muted that describes the dialog (aria-describedby).; DialogBody (data-slot dialog-body): The content between header and footer; scrolls when the dialog is taller than the viewport.; DialogFooter (data-slot dialog-footer): The actions at the end of the row, the primary action last.; DialogClose (data-slot dialog-close): Closes the dialog; unstyled, render a Button through render.
- size: sm, md, lg, xl
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", default "md"); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean | "trap-focus", default true); disablePointerDismissal (boolean, default false); showClose (boolean, default true); closeLabel (string, default "Close"); initialFocus (RefObject<HTMLElement> | boolean); finalFocus (RefObject<HTMLElement> | boolean); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.disabled, color.bg.layer, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.scrim, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, elevation.dialog.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.gentle, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.md, size.icon.lg, size.panel.lg, size.panel.md, size.panel.sm, size.panel.xl, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.stack.md, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.subtitle-1.leading, text.subtitle-1.size, text.subtitle-1.tracking, text.subtitle-1.weight, z.modal, z.overlay
- Accessibility: The popup is role="dialog", named by DialogTitle (aria-labelledby) and described by DialogDescription (aria-describedby); every dialog has a title. While it is open the rest of the page is hidden from assistive technology and inert (Base UI marks it, rather than setting aria-modal). Opening moves focus into the popup (the first focusable element, or initialFocus); Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside; closing returns focus to the trigger (or finalFocus). Escape closes the dialog, and so does a press on the scrim unless disablePointerDismissal is set; the page behind does not scroll and ignores the pointer while it is open. The close button is an IconButton with an accessible name (closeLabel, "Close" by default) and a visible focus ring. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off (motion-reduce:transition-none). The popup takes the theme and density of the region it is declared in, not only of <html>, so its contrast matches the page that opened it.

Examples (DialogMinimal, DialogRealistic):

```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogBody, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Kbd } from "@/components/ui/kbd";
import { Select, SelectItem } from "@/components/ui/select";

/** The smallest useful Dialog: a trigger, a title, a sentence and the actions. */
export function DialogMinimal() {
  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button appearance="secondary" />}>About DBee</DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>About DBee</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>Version 0.1.0, standalone desktop. Nothing is sent over the network except to the databases you approve.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <DialogFooter>
          <DialogClose render={<Button />}>Done</DialogClose>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

const formats = { csv: "CSV", tsv: "TSV", jsonl: "JSON Lines" };

const shortcuts: [string, string[]][] = [
  ["Command palette", ["Ctrl", "K"]],
  ["New query tab", ["Ctrl", "T"]],
  ["Run statement", ["Ctrl", "Enter"]],
  ["Cancel running statement", ["Shift", "Escape"]],
  ["Export result", ["Ctrl", "Shift", "S"]],
  ["Toggle sidebar", ["Ctrl", "B"]],
];

/**
 * DBee's dialogs, one per width: rename a tab (sm), export a result with a Select inside (md, the
 * Select's list opens above the dialog), the keyboard shortcuts (lg, a scrolling body) and the
 * details of a column (xl, no close button: the footer closes it).
 */
export function DialogRealistic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-inline-sm">
      <Dialog size="sm">
        <DialogTrigger render={<Button appearance="subtle" />}>Rename tab</DialogTrigger>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Rename tab</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel>Title</FieldLabel>
            <Input defaultValue="Orders by region" />
          </Field>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button appearance="subtle" />}>Cancel</DialogClose>
            <DialogClose render={<Button />}>Rename</DialogClose>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <Dialog>
        <DialogTrigger render={<Button appearance="secondary" />}>Export result</DialogTrigger>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Export result</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>The statement runs again and the whole result is written, not only the rows loaded in the grid.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogBody>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel>Format</FieldLabel>
              <Select items={formats} defaultValue="csv">
                {Object.entries(formats).map(([value, label]) => (
                  <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                    {label}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel>Null text</FieldLabel>
              <Input placeholder="empty" />
              <FieldDescription>Written for NULL values.</FieldDescription>
            </Field>
          </DialogBody>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button appearance="subtle" />}>Cancel</DialogClose>
            <Button>Choose file…</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <Dialog size="lg">
        <DialogTrigger render={<Button appearance="subtle" />}>Keyboard shortcuts</DialogTrigger>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Keyboard shortcuts</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>Every action is also in the command palette.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogBody>
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-stack-sm">
              {shortcuts.map(([action, keys]) => (
                <div key={action} className="contents">
                  <dt className="text-body text-fg">{action}</dt>
                  <dd className="flex gap-inline-xs">
                    {keys.map((key) => (
                      <Kbd key={key}>{key}</Kbd>
                    ))}
                  </dd>
                </div>
              ))}
            </dl>
          </DialogBody>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      <Dialog size="xl">
        <DialogTrigger render={<Button appearance="subtle" />}>Column details</DialogTrigger>
        <DialogContent showClose={false}>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>orders.created_at</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>timestamp with time zone, not null, default now()</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose render={<Button appearance="secondary" />}>Close</DialogClose>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### DropdownMenu

[dropdown-menu.json](dropdown-menu.json): A menu of actions opened from a button, on Base UI's Menu: items with shortcuts and a danger tone, checkbox and radio items, groups with labels, separators and submenus, on elevation.flyout (color.bg.overlay) at z.popover.

Usage: Use DropdownMenu for a list of actions or options behind one button: tab actions under a "more" IconButton, copy formats, view options. Compose it as DropdownMenu > DropdownMenuTrigger (render a Button or IconButton) + DropdownMenuContent > DropdownMenuItem (onClick; danger for a destructive one; DropdownMenuShortcut at the end), DropdownMenuCheckboxItem (checked, onCheckedChange), DropdownMenuRadioGroup (value, onValueChange) with DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuGroup with DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, and DropdownMenuSub > DropdownMenuSubTrigger + DropdownMenuSubContent for a submenu. For a menu on right-click use ContextMenu; for an app's menu row, Menubar; for a primary action with variants, SplitButton; for picking a form value, Select; for a searchable list of every command, CommandPalette.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/menu
- Parts: DropdownMenuTrigger (data-slot dropdown-menu-trigger): Opens the menu; unstyled, render a Button or IconButton. aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded.; DropdownMenuContent (data-slot dropdown-menu-content): The portal, the positioner and the menu.; DropdownMenuItem (data-slot dropdown-menu-item): role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.; DropdownMenuCheckboxItem (data-slot dropdown-menu-checkbox-item): role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.; DropdownMenuRadioGroup (data-slot dropdown-menu-radio-group): role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.; DropdownMenuRadioItem (data-slot dropdown-menu-radio-item): role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.; DropdownMenuGroup (data-slot dropdown-menu-group): role="group", named by its DropdownMenuLabel.; DropdownMenuLabel (data-slot dropdown-menu-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; DropdownMenuSeparator (data-slot dropdown-menu-separator): role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.; DropdownMenuShortcut (data-slot dropdown-menu-shortcut): The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; DropdownMenuSubTrigger (data-slot dropdown-menu-sub-trigger): An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.; DropdownMenuSubContent (data-slot dropdown-menu-sub-content): The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); modal (boolean, default true); side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" | "inline-start" | "inline-end", default "bottom"); align ("start" | "center" | "end", default "start"); danger (boolean, default false); closeOnClick (boolean, default true); disabled (boolean, default false); checked (boolean); value (unknown); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), submenu-open (data-popup-open), danger (data-danger), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.disabled, color.bg.layer, color.bg.overlay, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.lg, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The trigger has aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; the popup is role="menu" of role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" (aria-checked) and "menuitemradio" items; groups are role="group" named by their label. Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger opens the menu with the first item highlighted (ArrowUp: the last); arrow keys, Home and End move, typing jumps to an item, Enter or Space chooses, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. ArrowRight (inline-end) on a sub-trigger opens its submenu, ArrowLeft closes it. Disabled items stay reachable by the keyboard, as the ARIA menu pattern recommends, but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen. A press outside closes the menu. A destructive item has danger and a clear label, so the meaning does not rest on colour; checked state shows a check mark or dot as well as aria-checked. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the slide and fade transitions off. The menu and its submenus take the trigger's theme and density, and sit at z.popover so a menu opened from a dialog is above it.

Examples (DropdownMenuMinimal, DropdownMenuRealistic):

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuCheckboxItem,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuRadioGroup,
  DropdownMenuRadioItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuShortcut,
  DropdownMenuSub,
  DropdownMenuSubContent,
  DropdownMenuSubTrigger,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/icon-button";
import { MoreHorizontal } from "@/lib/icons";

/** The smallest useful DropdownMenu: a few actions under an icon button. */
export function DropdownMenuMinimal() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<IconButton aria-label="Tab actions" appearance="subtle" />}>
        <Icon icon={MoreHorizontal} />
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent>
        <DropdownMenuItem>Rename</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>Duplicate</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem danger>Close tab</DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}

/**
 * The results toolbar's copy menu: actions with shortcuts, a "Copy as" submenu, a radio group for
 * the delimiter, checkbox options, a disabled action and a group label.
 */
export function DropdownMenuRealistic() {
  const [delimiter, setDelimiter] = useState("tab");
  const [headers, setHeaders] = useState(true);
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button appearance="secondary" size="small" />}>Copy</DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent>
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuLabel>Selection</DropdownMenuLabel>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            Copy cells
            <DropdownMenuShortcut>Ctrl+C</DropdownMenuShortcut>
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            Copy with headers
            <DropdownMenuShortcut>Ctrl+Shift+C</DropdownMenuShortcut>
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuSub>
            <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>Copy as</DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuSubContent>
              <DropdownMenuItem>CSV</DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>JSON</DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>SQL INSERT statements</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuSubContent>
          </DropdownMenuSub>
          <DropdownMenuItem disabled>Copy column statistics</DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuLabel>Delimiter</DropdownMenuLabel>
          <DropdownMenuRadioGroup value={delimiter} onValueChange={(value) => setDelimiter(value as string)}>
            <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="tab">Tab</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
            <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="comma">Comma</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
            <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="semicolon">Semicolon</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
          </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
        </DropdownMenuGroup>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem checked={headers} onCheckedChange={setHeaders}>
          Include headers
        </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
```

### EmptyState

[empty-state.json](empty-state.json): What a view shows when it has nothing to show yet: an icon, a title, a sentence and the way forward; centered for a panel, inline for small places.

Usage: Use EmptyState wherever a list, tree, grid or panel can be empty: first run ("No connections yet" with Add connection), a query with no rows, a filter with no matches. Say what is missing and what to do; offer one primary action. Compose EmptyState > EmptyStateIcon, EmptyStateTitle, EmptyStateDescription, EmptyStateActions; all optional. variant="inline" for a tree or a narrow list. For an error use Alert; for loading use Skeleton or Spinner.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Parts: EmptyStateIcon (data-slot empty-state-icon): A decorative icon in a soft circle.; EmptyStateTitle (data-slot empty-state-title): What is missing, an <h3> by default.; EmptyStateDescription (data-slot empty-state-description): Why it is empty and what to do.; EmptyStateActions (data-slot empty-state-actions): The way forward: one primary Button, maybe a secondary one.
- variant: centered, inline
- Props: variant ("centered" | "inline", default "centered"); children (ReactNode); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.border.default, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, font.sans, radius.lg, radius.md, size.control.lg, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.sm, size.panel.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xl, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.subtitle-2.leading, text.subtitle-2.size, text.subtitle-2.tracking, text.subtitle-2.weight
- Accessibility: The title is a heading (<h3>) so screen-reader users find the empty view; render a <p> inside small places (a tree) where a heading would be noise. The icon is aria-hidden; the title and description carry the meaning. Actions are ordinary buttons in reading order; put the primary action first. Long titles and descriptions wrap.

Examples (EmptyStateMinimal, EmptyStateRealistic):

```tsx
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { EmptyState, EmptyStateActions, EmptyStateDescription, EmptyStateIcon, EmptyStateTitle } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
import { Database } from "@/lib/icons";

const DbIcon = () => <Icon icon={Database} />;

/** The smallest useful EmptyState: a title and a sentence. */
export function EmptyStateMinimal() {
  return (
    <EmptyState>
      <EmptyStateTitle>No rows</EmptyStateTitle>
      <EmptyStateDescription>The query ran and returned nothing.</EmptyStateDescription>
    </EmptyState>
  );
}

/** DBee's first run (centered, with actions) and a filter with no matches in the tree (inline, long text). */
export function EmptyStateRealistic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-stack-lg">
      <EmptyState className="rounded-lg border border-border">
        <EmptyStateIcon>
          <DbIcon />
        </EmptyStateIcon>
        <EmptyStateTitle>No connections yet</EmptyStateTitle>
        <EmptyStateDescription>Add a PostgreSQL connection. You approve what it may reach before it is created.</EmptyStateDescription>
        <EmptyStateActions>
          <Button>Add connection</Button>
          <Button appearance="subtle">Import from file</Button>
        </EmptyStateActions>
      </EmptyState>
      <EmptyState variant="inline" className="w-panel-xs rounded-md bg-inset">
        <EmptyStateIcon>
          <DbIcon />
        </EmptyStateIcon>
        <EmptyStateTitle render={<p />}>No matches</EmptyStateTitle>
        <EmptyStateDescription>No table in orders-prod matches customer_lifetime_value_by_region_and_month_v2.</EmptyStateDescription>
      </EmptyState>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Field

[field.json](field.json): A form field on Base UI's Field parts: label, control, description and error tied together, with invalid, touched, dirty and disabled state taken from TanStack Form or set by hand.

Usage: Wrap every form control (Input, Textarea, InputGroup) in a Field with a FieldLabel; add FieldDescription for a hint and FieldError for the message. A Checkbox or Switch goes inside its FieldLabel, next to the text. A group of options (RadioGroup, CheckboxGroup) is one Field: a FieldLegend first inside the group, then a FieldItem per option with its FieldLabel and, if needed, its own FieldDescription. Group related Fields under a heading with FieldSet and FieldLegend. With TanStack Form, render it from form.Field and pass the field: <form.Field name="host">{(field) => <Field field={field}>…</Field>}</form.Field>, and wire the control's value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field. Without a form library, set invalid and FieldError's children yourself, or use Base UI's validate prop. Put the fields in a Form.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/field
- Parts: FieldLabel (data-slot field-label): The visible label, tied to the control; an inline row with gap space.inline.sm, so it can wrap a Checkbox, Radio or Switch and its text; danger-coloured while invalid, dimmed while disabled.; FieldDescription (data-slot field-description): A hint under the control, in color.fg.muted, named by aria-describedby.; FieldError (data-slot field-error): The validation message in color.status.danger.fg: its children, its errors prop, or the TanStack field's errors one per line.; FieldItem (data-slot field-item): One option of a RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup: its FieldLabel and FieldDescription in a column with gap space.stack.xs; disabled disables that option.; FieldSet (data-slot field-set): A <fieldset> grouping related Fields under a FieldLegend, a column with gap space.stack.md; disabled disables every control inside.; FieldLegend (data-slot field-legend): The name of a FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup, placed first inside it, in text.label; the group's aria-labelledby points to it.
- Props: field (FieldState (a TanStack Form field: name and state.meta)); name (string); invalid (boolean); touched (boolean); dirty (boolean); disabled (boolean, default false); validate ((value, formValues) => string | string[] | null | Promise<…>); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.status.danger.fg, font.sans, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.stack.md, space.stack.xs, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: FieldLabel is a <label> tied to the control, so clicking it focuses the control and screen readers announce it as the control's name. FieldDescription and FieldError are named in the control's aria-describedby; the error is read when the control is focused. A FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup is named by its FieldLegend through aria-labelledby; a FieldDescription inside a FieldItem describes that option only. An invalid field sets aria-invalid on the control; FieldError shows Fluent's ErrorCircle (aria-hidden) before the message, and the message, not the danger colour, carries the meaning. Show errors after the user leaves the field or submits (the default with a TanStack field: touched and invalid), not on the first keystroke. color.status.danger.fg and color.fg.muted are contrast-checked as text on every surface.

Examples (FieldMinimal, FieldRealistic):

```tsx
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldItem, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group";

/** The smallest useful Field: a label and an input, tied together. */
export function FieldMinimal() {
  return (
    <Field>
      <FieldLabel>Database</FieldLabel>
      <Input placeholder="analytics" />
    </Field>
  );
}

/**
 * Connection details in a FieldSet: a hint, an invalid port with its message, a disabled driver,
 * and a group of options (FieldLegend, a FieldItem per option). Field state set by hand here; the
 * Form example drives the same parts from TanStack Form.
 */
export function FieldRealistic() {
  return (
    <FieldSet>
      <FieldLegend>Connection</FieldLegend>
      <Field name="host">
        <FieldLabel>Host</FieldLabel>
        <Input defaultValue="db.internal" />
        <FieldDescription>A name or address on your network.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="port" invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Port</FieldLabel>
        <Input size="small" defaultValue="99999" inputMode="numeric" />
        <FieldError>The port must be between 1 and 65535.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field name="driver" disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Driver</FieldLabel>
        <Input defaultValue="postgres" />
        <FieldDescription>Set by the workspace administrator.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="auth">
        <RadioGroup defaultValue="password">
          <FieldLegend>Authentication</FieldLegend>
          <FieldItem>
            <FieldLabel>
              <RadioGroupItem value="password" />
              Password
            </FieldLabel>
          </FieldItem>
          <FieldItem>
            <FieldLabel>
              <RadioGroupItem value="certificate" />
              Client certificate
            </FieldLabel>
            <FieldDescription>Uses the certificate in the workspace keychain.</FieldDescription>
          </FieldItem>
        </RadioGroup>
      </Field>
    </FieldSet>
  );
}
```

### FileInput

[file-input.json](file-input.json): A file picker on a native <input type="file"> (Base UI's Input), as one line like an Input or as a dashed dropzone, with a Clear button and accept filtering of dropped files.

Usage: Use FileInput to pick local files the app reads in the browser or sends with the form: a CA certificate, a key, SQL scripts to import. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; set accept (".pem,.crt", "image/*") and multiple as on the native input. Read the files from onFilesChange ([] when cleared); with TanStack Form, keep File[] in the field and call field.handleChange from onFilesChange. The dropzone variant also takes dropped files (filtered by accept) and suits imports; the field variant suits settings forms. Nothing is uploaded by the component; it has no network code. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- variant: field, dropzone
- Props: onFilesChange ((files: File[]) => void); accept (string); multiple (boolean, default false); variant ("field" | "dropzone", default "field"); appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); chooseLabel (string, default "Choose file"); emptyLabel (string, default "No file chosen"); dropLabel (string, default "Drop a file here, or"); clearLabel (string, default "Clear file"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: hover (hover), focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input]:focus-visible]), dragging (data-dragging), empty (data-empty), invalid (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input][data-invalid]]), disabled (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.accent.compound, color.accent.subtle-bg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.inner-width, ring.width, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: The control is a native <input type="file">, visually hidden but focusable: Tab reaches it, Space or Enter opens the system picker, and screen readers announce its label and the chosen file. The chip and the file names repeat what the input announces, so they are aria-hidden; the FieldLabel names the input and clicking it opens the picker. Dropping files is a pointer shortcut only; the same files can always be chosen with the keyboard. Announce what was added in a role="status" element. The Clear button is named "Clear file" and returns focus to the input. Focus shows Fluent's accent underline (shadow.focus-underline) along the frame's bottom, 3:1 on every fill and surface.

Examples (FileInputMinimal, FileInputRealistic):

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { FileInput } from "@/components/ui/file-input";

/** The smallest useful FileInput: a labelled file picker. */
export function FileInputMinimal() {
  return (
    <Field>
      <FieldLabel>CA certificate</FieldLabel>
      <FileInput accept=".pem,.crt" />
    </Field>
  );
}

/**
 * TLS files of a connection and an SQL import: a certificate with a hint, a required key that is
 * missing, a disabled picker, the small and large sizes, and a dropzone for several scripts that
 * lists what was dropped.
 */
export function FileInputRealistic() {
  const [scripts, setScripts] = useState<File[]>([]);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-stack-md">
      <Field name="cert">
        <FieldLabel>Client certificate</FieldLabel>
        <FileInput accept=".pem,.crt" />
        <FieldDescription>PEM or DER. Read on this machine, never uploaded.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="key" invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Client key</FieldLabel>
        <FileInput accept=".pem,.key" size="small" appearance="filled-darker" />
        <FieldError>Choose the key that matches the certificate.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field name="root" disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Root certificate</FieldLabel>
        <FileInput />
        <FieldDescription>Provided by the workspace.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="ssh">
        <FieldLabel>SSH identity</FieldLabel>
        <FileInput size="large" appearance="underline" />
      </Field>
      <Field name="scripts">
        <FieldLabel>SQL scripts</FieldLabel>
        <FileInput variant="dropzone" accept=".sql" multiple chooseLabel="Choose files" emptyLabel="No scripts yet" onFilesChange={setScripts} />
        <FieldDescription role="status">
          {scripts.length === 0 ? "Scripts run in the order you add them." : `${scripts.length} script${scripts.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} ready to run.`}
        </FieldDescription>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Form

[form.json](form.json): A <form> laid out as a column of Fields and submitted through TanStack Form: no native validation, handleSubmit on submit, focus on the first invalid field.

Usage: Create the form with useForm from @tanstack/react-form (defaultValues, validators, onSubmit), pass it as form, and render each field with form.Field and a Field inside. For a native-like flow use validationLogic: revalidateLogic({ mode: "submit", modeAfterSubmission: "change" }); for per-field checks use validators.onBlur. Show the submit state with form.Subscribe and Button's loading. Without form, Form is only a styled <form>.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Props: form (AnyFormApi (from useForm)); noValidate (boolean); onSubmit ((event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => void); aria-label (string); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLFormElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: space.stack.md
- Accessibility: Renders a native <form>, so Enter in a text field submits it; keep a type="submit" Button in it. After a failed submit, focus moves to the first invalid control in document order, and its FieldError is read through aria-describedby. Name the form with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has more than one. Errors appear on submit and then follow each change (revalidateLogic) or on blur, never on the first keystroke of an untouched field. Announce the outcome of a submission in a role="status" region; the submit Button's loading sets aria-busy.

Examples (FormMinimal, FormRealistic):

```tsx
import { revalidateLogic, useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Form } from "@/components/ui/form";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";

/** The smallest useful Form: one validated field and a submit button. */
export function FormMinimal() {
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState("");
  const form = useForm({
    defaultValues: { table: "orders" },
    onSubmit: ({ value }) => setSaved(value.table),
  });
  return (
    <Form form={form} aria-label="Rename table">
      <form.Field name="table" validators={{ onBlur: ({ value }) => (/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/.test(value) ? undefined : "Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores.") }}>
        {(field) => (
          <Field field={field}>
            <FieldLabel>New name</FieldLabel>
            <Input value={field.state.value} onValueChange={field.handleChange} onBlur={field.handleBlur} />
            <FieldError />
          </Field>
        )}
      </form.Field>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-inline-md">
        <Button type="submit">Rename</Button>
        <p role="status" className="text-caption text-fg-muted">
          {saved && `Renamed to ${saved}.`}
        </p>
      </div>
    </Form>
  );
}

interface Connection {
  name: string;
  host: string;
  port: string;
  database: string;
  user: string;
  password: string;
  notes: string;
}

/** The checks of the connection form: every message names what to do. */
function validateConnection(value: Connection): Partial<Record<keyof Connection, string>> {
  const errors: Partial<Record<keyof Connection, string>> = {};
  if (!value.name.trim()) errors.name = "Give the connection a name.";
  if (!value.host.trim()) errors.host = "Enter the server's host name or address.";
  else if (/\s/.test(value.host)) errors.host = "A host name has no spaces.";
  const port = Number(value.port);
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(value.port) || port < 1 || port > 65535) errors.port = "Use a port from 1 to 65535.";
  if (!value.database.trim()) errors.database = "Enter the database to open.";
  if (!value.user.trim()) errors.user = "Enter the user to sign in as.";
  if (value.notes.length > 200) errors.notes = `Keep notes to 200 characters (now ${value.notes.length}).`;
  return errors;
}

/**
 * A database connection form: validated on submit, then on every change (revalidateLogic), each
 * error under its field, focus on the first invalid field, and a loading button while saving.
 */
export function FormRealistic() {
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState("");
  const form = useForm({
```
