```tsx
    defaultValues: { name: "", host: "", port: "5432", database: "", user: "", password: "", notes: "" } satisfies Connection as Connection,
    validationLogic: revalidateLogic({ mode: "submit", modeAfterSubmission: "change" }),
    validators: {
      onDynamic: ({ value }) => {
        const fields = validateConnection(value);
        return Object.keys(fields).length > 0 ? { fields } : undefined;
      },
    },
    onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
      setSaved(`Saved ${value.name}.`);
    },
  });
  return (
    <Form form={form} aria-label="New connection" className="w-full">
      <form.Field name="name">
        {(field) => (
          <Field field={field}>
            <FieldLabel>Name</FieldLabel>
            <Input value={field.state.value} onValueChange={field.handleChange} onBlur={field.handleBlur} placeholder="Analytics (production)" />
            <FieldError />
          </Field>
        )}
      </form.Field>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-inline-md">
        <form.Field name="host">
          {(field) => (
            <Field field={field} className="flex-1">
              <FieldLabel>Host</FieldLabel>
              <Input value={field.state.value} onValueChange={field.handleChange} onBlur={field.handleBlur} placeholder="db.internal" autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} />
              <FieldDescription>A name or address on your network.</FieldDescription>
              <FieldError />
            </Field>
          )}
        </form.Field>
        <form.Field name="port">
          {(field) => (
            <Field field={field}>
              <FieldLabel>Port</FieldLabel>
              <Input value={field.state.value} onValueChange={field.handleChange} onBlur={field.handleBlur} inputMode="numeric" />
              <FieldError />
            </Field>
          )}
        </form.Field>
      </div>
      <form.Field name="database">
        {(field) => (
          <Field field={field}>
            <FieldLabel>Database</FieldLabel>
            <Input value={field.state.value} onValueChange={field.handleChange} onBlur={field.handleBlur} placeholder="analytics" spellCheck={false} />
            <FieldError />
          </Field>
        )}
      </form.Field>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-inline-md">
        <form.Field name="user">
          {(field) => (
            <Field field={field} className="flex-1">
              <FieldLabel>User</FieldLabel>
              <Input value={field.state.value} onValueChange={field.handleChange} onBlur={field.handleBlur} autoComplete="username" spellCheck={false} />
              <FieldError />
            </Field>
          )}
        </form.Field>
        <form.Field name="password">
          {(field) => (
            <Field field={field} className="flex-1">
              <FieldLabel>Password</FieldLabel>
              <Input type="password" value={field.state.value} onValueChange={field.handleChange} onBlur={field.handleBlur} autoComplete="current-password" />
              <FieldDescription>Stored in the system keychain, never in the workspace file.</FieldDescription>
            </Field>
          )}
        </form.Field>
      </div>
      <form.Field name="notes">
        {(field) => (
          <Field field={field}>
            <FieldLabel>Notes</FieldLabel>
            <Textarea value={field.state.value} onValueChange={field.handleChange} onBlur={field.handleBlur} rows={2} />
            <FieldDescription>Optional, up to 200 characters.</FieldDescription>
            <FieldError />
          </Field>
        )}
      </form.Field>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-inline-md">
        <form.Subscribe selector={(state) => state.isSubmitting}>{(submitting) => <Button type="submit" loading={submitting}>Save connection</Button>}</form.Subscribe>
        <Button appearance="subtle" onClick={() => form.reset()}>
          Reset
        </Button>
        <p role="status" className="text-caption text-fg-muted">
          {saved}
        </p>
      </div>
    </Form>
  );
}
```

### GraphView

[graph-view.json](graph-view.json): A read-only directed graph laid out in layers (dagre), with pan, zoom, groups, running and visited nodes, and keyboard navigation along its edges.

Usage: Use GraphView to show how steps connect: a LangGraph assistant's nodes and edges (Mightyconsole), a workflow, a pipeline. Pass nodes and edges; kind start and end draw small pills, conditional edges are dashed, and nodes with a group are drawn inside that group's box (a subgraph seen with xray). While something runs, pass activeIds (accent fill) and visitedIds (accent edge): the edges between them light up too. selectedId and onNodeSelect make nodes selectable (click or Enter); onNodeOpen takes a double-click. A node with a detail draws two lines (a workflow ID, then its status dot, status and type), emphasis marks the node the graph is about, and dashed edges show messages between nodes (signals) rather than steps. Give it a height (h-panel-md, h-full in a sized panel); it fits the graph on first draw and when the graph or its size changes. The layout is computed, not measured, so labels longer than about 28 characters are cut with an ellipsis (the full label is the node's tooltip and name). For a hierarchy use Tree; for a timeline of steps, Timeline; to edit a graph, nothing here: it is read-only.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Props: nodes ({ id: string; label: string; kind?: "start" | "end" | "node" | "subgraph"; group?: string; detail?: string; tone?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger"; emphasis?: boolean }[]); edges ({ source: string; target: string; conditional?: boolean; dashed?: boolean; label?: string }[]); groups ({ id: string; label: string }[], default "[]"); direction ("TB" | "LR", default "\"TB\""); activeIds (string[], default "[]"); visitedIds (string[], default "[]"); selectedId (string | null, default "null"); onNodeSelect ((id: string) => void); onNodeOpen ((id: string) => void); aria-label (string, default "\"Graph\""); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: active (data-active), visited (data-visited), selected (data-selected), panning (data-panning), hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), detail (data-detail)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.compound, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-bg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.disabled, color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.default, color.border.disabled, color.border.strong, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.interactive.selected-hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.solid, color.status.info.solid, elevation.layer.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.sm, size.icon.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.md, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: The root is a named group (aria-roledescription "graph"); the nodes are buttons with one tab stop between them (roving tabindex), in layout order. Arrow keys along the direction follow the edges (Down or Right to the next node, Up or Left back); the other two move across the same layer; Home and End go to the first and last node; Enter or Space selects; + and - zoom, 0 fits. A node's name says its state (", running", ", done"); the edges are a visually hidden list ("plan to tools (conditional)"), so the shape is readable without the drawing. Conditional edges differ by their dash, not only by colour; running nodes by their fill and their name. Focus shows the double ring: ring.width in color.ring around ring.inner-width in color.ring-inner (3:1 on every surface).

Examples (GraphViewMinimal, GraphViewRealistic):

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { GraphView, type GraphViewEdge, type GraphViewGroup, type GraphViewNode } from "@/components/ui/graph-view";

const PIPELINE_NODES: GraphViewNode[] = [
  { id: "extract", label: "extract" },
  { id: "transform", label: "transform" },
  { id: "load", label: "load" },
];
const PIPELINE_EDGES: GraphViewEdge[] = [
  { source: "extract", target: "transform" },
  { source: "transform", target: "load" },
];

/** The smallest useful GraphView: three steps in a row. */
export function GraphViewMinimal() {
  return <GraphView aria-label="Pipeline" nodes={PIPELINE_NODES} edges={PIPELINE_EDGES} direction="LR" className="h-panel-xs" />;
}

// A LangGraph agent drawn with xray: a conditional edge, a loop back from the tool node, a
// subgraph's nodes in their group; a run is on "approve" after plan and tools.
const AGENT_NODES: GraphViewNode[] = [
  { id: "__start__", label: "start", kind: "start" },
  { id: "plan", label: "plan" },
  { id: "tools", label: "tools" },
  { id: "approve", label: "approve" },
  { id: "summarize:remember", label: "remember", group: "summarize" },
  { id: "summarize:format", label: "format", group: "summarize" },
  { id: "__end__", label: "end", kind: "end" },
];
const AGENT_EDGES: GraphViewEdge[] = [
  { source: "__start__", target: "plan" },
  { source: "plan", target: "tools", conditional: true, label: "tools" },
  { source: "plan", target: "approve", conditional: true },
  { source: "tools", target: "plan" },
  { source: "approve", target: "summarize:remember" },
  { source: "summarize:remember", target: "summarize:format" },
  { source: "summarize:format", target: "__end__" },
];
const AGENT_GROUPS: GraphViewGroup[] = [{ id: "summarize", label: "summarize" }];

/** An assistant's graph during a run: visited nodes, the running one, a selected node. */
export function GraphViewRealistic() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>("tools");
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-stack-sm">
      <GraphView
        aria-label="Graph of the agent assistant"
        nodes={AGENT_NODES}
        edges={AGENT_EDGES}
        groups={AGENT_GROUPS}
        visitedIds={["__start__", "plan", "tools"]}
        activeIds={["approve"]}
        selectedId={selected}
        onNodeSelect={setSelected}
        className="h-panel-md"
      />
      <p className="text-caption-1 text-fg-muted">Selected: {selected ?? "none"}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### HexView

[hex-view.json](hex-view.json): Bytes as a hex dump: an offset column, the bytes in hex and as ASCII, virtualized, with keyboard selection and copy as hex or as text.

Usage: Use HexView to show binary payloads exactly: a message's raw key or value, a file's first bytes, a protocol frame. Set the height with className (it scrolls inside). Arrows move the active byte, Shift extends the selection, Ctrl+A selects everything, Ctrl+C copies the selection as hex and Ctrl+Shift+C as text (UTF-8 when it decodes, else Latin-1 with dots); the footer's buttons do the same, and onCopy reports the text. baseOffset numbers a slice of a larger payload. For decoded values use JsonViewer or CodeBlock; for one short value inline, Code.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Props: bytes (Uint8Array | number[], default "empty"); bytesPerRow (number, default 16); baseOffset (number, default 0); onCopy ((text: string, format: "hex" | "text") => void); aria-label (string, default "Bytes"); overscan (number, default 8); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: selected (data-selected), active (data-active), non-printable (data-dot), hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, editor.bg, editor.fg, editor.gutter, editor.selection, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.md, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, syntax.string, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, text.code-sm.leading, text.code-sm.size, text.code-sm.tracking, text.code-sm.weight
- Accessibility: The bytes are an ARIA grid (role="grid", aria-readonly, aria-multiselectable) with one tab stop; the active byte is aria-activedescendant and is always rendered, even while scrolled away. Each byte cell is labelled with its offset and value ("1f: 6c"); each row has its offset as rowheader and its ASCII as one cell labelled "text: …". The footer announces the selection (aria-live="polite") and its copy buttons are ordinary buttons. Focus shows the double ring on the grid and a ring on the active byte: ring.width in color.ring.

Examples (HexViewMinimal, HexViewRealistic):

```tsx
import { HexView } from "@/components/ui/hex-view";

const encoder = new TextEncoder();

/** The smallest useful HexView. */
export function HexViewMinimal() {
  return <HexView bytes={encoder.encode("Hello, Mightyconsole")} className="h-panel-xs" aria-label="Payload bytes" />;
}

/** A Kafka value in the Confluent wire format: magic byte 0, the schema id, then Avro bytes. */
export function HexViewRealistic() {
  const body = encoder.encode("\u0008o-17\u0006c-9\u0002\u0004ÒPAID");
  const bytes = new Uint8Array([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x07, ...body, ...Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => (i * 37) & 0xff)]);
  return <HexView bytes={bytes} className="h-panel-xs" aria-label="Raw value of record 41" />;
}
```

### HoverCard

[hover-card.json](hover-card.json): A preview of what a link points to, on Base UI's PreviewCard: shown while the pointer rests on the link or the link has keyboard focus, styled as a Popover, size.panel.sm wide.

Usage: Use HoverCard to preview the target of a link without leaving the page: a table name in a message, a foreign key, a connection in the status bar. Compose it as HoverCard > HoverCardTrigger (the link: href and the page's link classes) + HoverCardContent (side, align) with read-only content. The link must work without the card and the card must not hold anything the user needs to click: it disappears when the pointer leaves. For a label on an icon button use Tooltip; for controls the user clicks to open, Popover.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/preview-card
- Parts: HoverCardTrigger (data-slot hover-card-trigger): The link (an <a>); give it href and the page's link classes.; HoverCardContent (data-slot hover-card-content): The portal, the positioner and the card.
- Props: open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); delay (number, default 600); closeDelay (number, default 300); href (string); side ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" | "inline-start" | "inline-end", default "bottom"); align ("start" | "center" | "end", default "start"); className (string)
- States: open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.link, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.ring, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, radius.lg, radius.xs, ring.offset, ring.width, size.panel.sm, space.inline.sm, space.inset.md, space.stack.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The trigger is an ordinary link, named by its text; it works (Enter follows it) whether or not the card opens. The card opens on hover after delay and on keyboard focus of the link; Escape closes it and focus stays on the link; leaving the link and the card closes it after closeDelay. The card is supplementary and read-only: nothing in it is required to complete a task, so screen-reader users lose nothing when it is not announced. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the slide and fade transitions off. The card takes the link's theme and density and sits at z.popover.

Examples (HoverCardMinimal, HoverCardRealistic):

```tsx
import { HoverCard, HoverCardContent, HoverCardTrigger } from "@/components/ui/hover-card";

const link = "rounded-xs text-fg-link underline underline-offset-4 outline-none focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-[length:var(--by-ring-width)] focus-visible:outline-offset-[var(--by-ring-offset)] focus-visible:outline-ring";

/** The smallest useful HoverCard: a table name in a message previews the table. */
export function HoverCardMinimal() {
  return (
    <p className="text-body text-fg">
      Rows were read from{" "}
      <HoverCard>
        <HoverCardTrigger href="#public.orders" className={link}>
          public.orders
        </HoverCardTrigger>
        <HoverCardContent>
          <p className="text-body-strong text-fg">public.orders</p>
          <p className="text-body text-fg-muted">Table, 1,204,331 rows, 12 columns.</p>
        </HoverCardContent>
      </HoverCard>
      .
    </p>
  );
}

const columns = [
  ["id", "bigint", "not null"],
  ["customer_id", "bigint", "not null"],
  ["status", "text", "null"],
  ["created_at", "timestamptz", "not null"],
];

/** A foreign key in a column list previews the referenced table's columns (open from the start, so the gallery shows it). */
export function HoverCardRealistic() {
  return (
    <p className="text-body text-fg">
      customer_id references{" "}
      <HoverCard defaultOpen>
        <HoverCardTrigger href="#public.customers" delay={300} className={link}>
          public.customers
        </HoverCardTrigger>
        <HoverCardContent side="right">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-stack-xs">
            <p className="text-body-strong text-fg">public.customers</p>
            <p className="text-caption text-fg-muted">Table in orders-prod, 88,410 rows</p>
          </div>
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-stack-xs">
            {columns.map(([name, type, nullable]) => (
              <li key={name} className="flex items-center gap-inline-sm text-body">
                <span className="font-mono text-code text-fg">{name}</span>
                <span className="text-caption text-fg-muted">{type}</span>
                <span className="ms-auto text-caption text-fg-subtle">{nullable}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </HoverCardContent>
      </HoverCard>
      .
    </p>
  );
}
```

### Icon

[icon.json](icon.json): A Fluent UI System Icon (vendored offline, MIT) as an inline svg: regular or filled artwork, sized by size.icon.*, coloured by currentColor or a token text role.

Usage: Use Icon for every pictogram: <Icon icon={ChevronDown} /> with an export of @/lib/icons (ChevronDown, Database, Search, Dismiss). It takes the surrounding text colour (tone="inherit"), or a role through tone (muted, accent, danger, warning, success, info). size follows size.icon.* (xs 12, sm 14, md 16, lg 20, xl 24 px) and picks Fluent's 16, 20 or 24 px drawing. filled is Fluent's solid style, for a selected or active state. An icon beside text is decorative (hidden from screen readers); one that stands alone needs label, or put it in an IconButton with aria-label. Import only the icons you use. To add an icon, vendor it with pnpm --filter @byterygon/ui icons add <name> --from <@fluentui/svg-icons tarball> (offline), never draw one by hand.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- size: xs, sm, md, lg, xl
- tone: inherit, default, muted, subtle, accent, danger, warning, success, info
- Props: icon (IconDefinition); size ("xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", default "md"); tone ("inherit" | "default" | "muted" | "subtle" | "accent" | "danger" | "warning" | "success" | "info", default "inherit"); filled (boolean, default false); label (string); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<SVGSVGElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.status.danger.fg, color.status.info.fg, color.status.success.fg, color.status.warning.fg, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xl, size.icon.xs
- Accessibility: Renders an inline svg with focusable="false"; it is never in the tab order. Decorative by default (aria-hidden): the text next to it says what it means. A standalone icon takes label (role="img" with aria-label), or sits in an IconButton whose aria-label says what the button does. Colour is never the only cue: a status icon (Info, Warning, ErrorCircle, CheckmarkCircle) differs in shape too, and status text goes with it. Tones use text roles checked at 4.5:1 on their surfaces.

Examples (IconMinimal, IconRealistic):

```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/icon-button";
import { ArrowClockwise, ArrowDownload, CheckmarkCircle, Database, ErrorCircle, Info, Play, Search, Settings, Star, Warning } from "@/lib/icons";

/** The smallest useful Icon: decorative beside text, which already says what it means. */
export function IconMinimal() {
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-inline-xs text-body-1 text-fg">
      <Icon icon={Database} />
      orders_db
    </span>
  );
}

/** Icon where it is really used: every size, the tones, regular and filled, inside a button, and named when it stands alone. */
export function IconRealistic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-stack-md text-fg">
      <div className="flex items-end gap-inline-md">
        <Icon icon={Settings} size="xs" />
        <Icon icon={Settings} size="sm" />
        <Icon icon={Settings} size="md" />
        <Icon icon={Settings} size="lg" />
        <Icon icon={Settings} size="xl" />
        <Icon icon={Star} size="xl" filled tone="accent" label="Starred" />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-inline-md">
        <Icon icon={Search} tone="default" />
        <Icon icon={Search} tone="muted" />
        <Icon icon={Search} tone="subtle" />
        <Icon icon={Info} tone="info" label="Information" />
        <Icon icon={CheckmarkCircle} tone="success" label="Succeeded" />
        <Icon icon={Warning} tone="warning" label="Warning" />
        <Icon icon={ErrorCircle} tone="danger" label="Failed" />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-inline-sm">
        <Button>
          <Icon icon={Play} filled />
          Run
        </Button>
        <Button appearance="secondary">
          <Icon icon={ArrowDownload} />
          Export
        </Button>
        <IconButton aria-label="Refresh">
          <Icon icon={ArrowClockwise} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### IconButton

[icon-button.json](icon-button.json): A square, icon-only action button (Fluent 2's icon-only Button) with Button's appearances in small, medium and large, disabled and loading states, and a required aria-label.

Usage: Use IconButton where a familiar icon says enough and space is tight: toolbars, table rows, inside an InputGroup. Put an Icon (`<Icon icon={Copy} />`, @/lib/icons) inside and describe the action in aria-label ("Copy connection string", not "Copy icon"); the type requires it. Subtle is the default; use primary for the one main action of a toolbar. When the icon is not obvious, use a Button with text instead. The old variant prop (ghost is subtle) and sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/button
- appearance: primary, secondary, outline, subtle, transparent, danger
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: aria-label (string); appearance ("primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "subtle" | "transparent" | "danger", default "subtle"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); variant ("primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger", deprecated: use appearance (ghost is subtle)); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); loading (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); type ("button" | "submit" | "reset", default "button"); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled), loading (data-loading)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.disabled, color.bg.layer, color.border.control-bottom-subtle, color.border.default, color.border.disabled, color.border.strong, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.solid, color.status.danger.solid-fg, color.status.danger.solid-hover, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.xl, space.inline.sm
- Accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it. aria-label is required by the type and names the action; Icon is aria-hidden without its own label, so the name is not read twice. Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy. The small size (size.control.sm, 22 px in compact) passes WCAG 2.2 target size (minimum 24 px) only with spacing around it; keep IconButtons at least gap-inline-xs apart, or use medium in dense toolbars. The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only: an outline in color.ring (kept in forced-colours mode) around color.ring-inner, at least 3:1 on every surface and layer; every appearance's colours are contrast-checked by the token build.

Examples (IconButtonMinimal, IconButtonRealistic):

```tsx
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/icon-button";
import { ArrowClockwise, Copy, Delete, MoreHorizontal, Play } from "@/lib/icons";

/** The smallest useful IconButton: an icon and the label a screen reader announces. */
export function IconButtonMinimal() {
  return (
    <IconButton aria-label="Copy connection string">
      <Icon icon={Copy} />
    </IconButton>
  );
}

/** A query editor's toolbar: run, refresh while loading, a disabled delete, more actions, in every appearance and size. */
export function IconButtonRealistic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-stack-sm">
      <div role="toolbar" aria-label="Query" className="flex items-center gap-inline-xs">
        <IconButton appearance="primary" aria-label="Run query">
          <Icon icon={Play} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton aria-label="Refresh results" loading>
          <Icon icon={ArrowClockwise} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton appearance="danger" aria-label="Delete query" disabled>
          <Icon icon={Delete} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton appearance="secondary" aria-label="More actions">
          <Icon icon={MoreHorizontal} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton appearance="outline" aria-label="Copy query">
          <Icon icon={Copy} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton appearance="transparent" aria-label="Copy result">
          <Icon icon={Copy} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-inline-xs">
        <IconButton size="small" aria-label="Copy, small">
          <Icon icon={Copy} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton size="medium" aria-label="Copy, medium">
          <Icon icon={Copy} />
        </IconButton>
        <IconButton size="large" aria-label="Copy, large">
          <Icon icon={Copy} />
        </IconButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Input

[input.json](input.json): A single-line text input in Fluent's small, medium and large, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Base UI Field.

Usage: Put Input inside a Field with a FieldLabel (and FieldDescription and FieldError as needed); it takes the label, description and validity from it. Use Textarea for multi-line text and InputGroup for an icon, a unit or a button attached to the input. Match the size to the controls beside it. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); value (string); defaultValue (string); onValueChange ((value: string, details) => void); disabled (boolean, default false); aria-invalid (boolean | "true" | "false"); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (aria-invalid), invalid-in-field (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.subtle, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, space.control.x, space.inset.md, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: Renders a native <input>; give it a visible <label> (or a Base UI Field.Label), or aria-label when there is no room for one. Placeholder text is a hint, not a label; it uses color.fg.subtle, contrast-checked on every surface. Mark errors with aria-invalid and point aria-describedby at the message; the danger hairline and bottom edge is not the only signal. The bottom edge (color.border.control-bottom) meets 3:1 on every fill and surface a field takes, as WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control's boundary; the hairline (color.border.subtle) is decoration. Focus shows Fluent's accent underline (shadow.focus-underline).

Examples (InputMinimal, InputRealistic):

```tsx
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

/** The smallest useful Input: a labelled text field. */
export function InputMinimal() {
  return <Input aria-label="Table name" placeholder="customers" />;
}

/**
 * A connection form: the four Fluent appearances, the three sizes, a hint, an invalid field with
 * its message, and a disabled field.
 */
export function InputRealistic() {
  return (
    <form className="flex flex-col gap-stack-md">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Host</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="host" defaultValue="db.internal" />
        <FieldDescription>A name or address on your network.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Port</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="port" size="small" defaultValue="99999" />
        <FieldError>The port must be between 1 and 65535.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Database</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="database" appearance="underline" placeholder="postgres" />
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>User</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="user" appearance="filled-darker" defaultValue="analyst" />
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Ghi chú</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="note" appearance="filled-lighter" size="large" defaultValue="Kết nối chỉ đọc cho báo cáo" />
      </Field>
      <Field disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Driver</FieldLabel>
        <Input name="driver" defaultValue="postgres" />
      </Field>
    </form>
  );
}
```

### InputGroup

[input-group.json](input-group.json): A text input with prefixes and suffixes attached (icons, text such as a scheme or a unit, ghost buttons), in one frame that shows focus, invalid and disabled; works inside a Field.

Usage: Use InputGroup when something belongs to the input: a search icon, a fixed prefix (postgres://), a unit (ms), or an action on the value (Copy, Test, Show). Put InputGroupAddon and InputGroupButton before or after InputGroupInput in the order they should appear, and wrap the group in a Field for its label and error. For an unrelated action next to an input, use a plain Input and a Button side by side. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- Parts: InputGroupInput (data-slot input-group-input): The text control (Base UI's Input): takes a Field's label and validity; its value, onValueChange and onBlur as Input's.; InputGroupAddon (data-slot input-group-addon): An icon or text in color.fg.muted; clicking it focuses the control.; InputGroupButton (data-slot input-group-button): A Button (ghost by default) one size smaller than the group, inset from the frame; Button's props.
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input]:focus-visible]), invalid (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][aria-invalid=true]]), invalid-in-field (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-invalid]]), disabled (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.xl, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: The control is a native <input>; give it a FieldLabel through a Field, or aria-label. Addon text is not part of its name: say in the label or description what a prefix means. Icon is aria-hidden in an addon unless it has a label; an icon-only InputGroupButton needs aria-label. Tab moves from the control to the button; the frame's focus underline follows the control, the button has its own double focus ring. Clicking an addon focuses the control, so the whole frame is a click target. The frame's bottom edge (color.border.control-bottom) meets 3:1 on every fill and surface; invalid turns the hairline color.status.danger.border and the bottom edge color.status.danger.solid (3:1), with FieldError's message, not colour alone.

Examples (InputGroupMinimal, InputGroupRealistic):

```tsx
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Icon } from "@/components/ui/icon";
import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton, InputGroupInput } from "@/components/ui/input-group";
import { Search } from "@/lib/icons";

/** The smallest useful InputGroup: a search field with an icon. */
export function InputGroupMinimal() {
  return (
    <InputGroup>
      <InputGroupAddon>
        <Icon icon={Search} />
      </InputGroupAddon>
      <InputGroupInput aria-label="Search tables" placeholder="Search tables" />
    </InputGroup>
  );
}

/** Connection settings: a scheme prefix with a Test button, an invalid value with a unit and a Reset button, a disabled path. */
export function InputGroupRealistic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-stack-md">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>Server</FieldLabel>
        <InputGroup>
          <InputGroupAddon>postgres://</InputGroupAddon>
          <InputGroupInput defaultValue="db.internal:5432/analytics" />
          <InputGroupButton>Test</InputGroupButton>
        </InputGroup>
        <FieldDescription>Host, port and database.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Statement timeout</FieldLabel>
        <InputGroup size="small" appearance="filled-darker">
          <InputGroupInput defaultValue="-5" inputMode="numeric" />
          <InputGroupAddon>ms</InputGroupAddon>
          <InputGroupButton>Reset</InputGroupButton>
        </InputGroup>
        <FieldError>Use 0 (no limit) or a positive number.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Socket directory</FieldLabel>
        <InputGroup size="large" appearance="underline">
          <InputGroupAddon>unix:</InputGroupAddon>
          <InputGroupInput defaultValue="/var/run/postgresql" />
        </InputGroup>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### JsonViewer

[json-viewer.json](json-viewer.json): A JSON value as a keyboard-navigable, virtualized tree or as text, in the editor's syntax colours, with a toolbar (Copy, Expand all, Collapse all, Expand to depth, Find, Tree | Text) and a context menu on every row.

Usage: Use JsonViewer to read any JSON value: a payload, an inspect result, a schema, a response, DBee's value viewer for json and jsonb cells. One component gives every place the same tools: Copy (the whole value, formatted or minified), Expand all (capped at maxExpandRows, with a message), Collapse all, Expand to depth, Find (Mod+F, in keys and values of the tree or in the text, with a count, next and previous and case), and a Tree | Text switch. Pass value (parsed) or text (parsed here; invalid JSON shows an alert with the parser's message). defaultExpandDepth sets how much is open at first. defaultMode="text" starts in Text (a request body, an event as stored); mode and onModeChange let the app remember the choice. A row has a context menu and keys: Copy value (Mod+C), Copy path in jq style such as .items[0].id (Mod+Shift+C) and Copy key (Mod+Alt+C). The tool's own buttons go in the toolbar through `actions`; do not import app code into the component. Give it a height (h-panel-sm, h-full in a sized panel): it renders only the rows in view, so large arrays stay fast. onActiveChange gives the JSON Pointer of the row the keyboard is on. Use CodeBlock for code that is not data (a command, a snippet), CodeEditor to edit JSON. Pass a stable value (memoize it): a new value object resets what is open.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Props: value (unknown); text (string); defaultExpandDepth (number, default 1); aria-label (string, default "\"JSON\""); onActiveChange ((path: string, value: unknown) => void); maxStringLength (number, default 1000); overscan (number, default 10); invalidText (ReactNode, default "\"Not valid JSON:\""); mode ("tree" | "text"); defaultMode ("tree" | "text", default "\"tree\""); onModeChange ((mode: "tree" | "text") => void); toolbar (boolean, default true); actions (ReactNode); maxExpandRows (number, default 200000); onCopy ((kind: "value" | "path" | "key" | "formatted" | "minified", text: string) => void); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: active (data-active), expanded (data-expanded), match (data-match), current-match (data-current-match), hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (data-invalid)
- Tokens: border.width.1, color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.layer, color.border.default, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.fg, editor.bg, editor.fg, editor.gutter, editor.line-highlight, editor.match, editor.selection, font.mono, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xs, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, syntax.constant, syntax.identifier, syntax.number, syntax.operator, syntax.string, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, text.code-sm.leading, text.code-sm.size, text.code-sm.tracking, text.code-sm.weight
- Accessibility: The ARIA treeview pattern: one tab stop (role="tree") with aria-activedescendant naming the active row (always rendered, even outside the window); rows are role="treeitem" with aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset and aria-expanded on containers. Keys: Up and Down move, Right opens a container then enters it, Left closes it then goes to its parent, Home and End go to the ends, Enter and Space toggle; Mod+C, Mod+Shift+C and Mod+Alt+C copy the active row's value, jq path and key; Mod+F opens Find, Enter and Shift+Enter (or F3) step through the matches, Escape closes it. The toolbar is role="toolbar" with one tab stop and arrow keys between its buttons; the Tree | Text switch is a group of two pressed-state buttons. Find announces its count (3 of 17) in a polite live region; a copy announces what it copied in a status region. Keys, indices and values are text; colour (syntax.*) only repeats the kind, and strings keep their quotes. A matching row is marked by a background, and the count says where the match is. Invalid text renders role="alert" with the parser's message. Virtualized: only rows in view are in the DOM, so screen readers move row by row with the keys rather than reading the whole value. Text mode is a focusable, scrollable region of selectable text.

Examples (JsonViewerMinimal, JsonViewerRealistic):

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { JsonViewer, type JsonViewerMode } from "@/components/ui/json-viewer";
import { ToolbarButton } from "@/components/ui/toolbar";

/** The smallest useful JsonViewer: a small object, with the toolbar's Copy, Expand all, Find and Tree | Text. */
export function JsonViewerMinimal() {
  return <JsonViewer aria-label="Cell value" value={{ id: 1204, status: "open", paid: false, note: null }} className="h-panel-sm max-w-panel-md" />;
}

/**
 * A jsonb cell with nesting and a long string; an array of 100,000 events (virtualized in the tree
 * and in the text); a request read as text, with the mode remembered by the app and a tool's own
 * button in the `actions` slot; and invalid JSON text.
 */
export function JsonViewerRealistic() {
  const events = useMemo(() => ({ total: 100_000, items: Array.from({ length: 100_000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, type: i % 3 ? "view" : "click" })) }), []);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<JsonViewerMode>("text");
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full min-w-0 max-w-panel-xl flex-wrap items-start gap-gap-lg">
      <JsonViewer
        aria-label="payload of order 1204"
        defaultExpandDepth={2}
        value={{
          id: 1204,
          customer: { id: 77, name: "Analyst Two", tags: ["vip", "eu"] },
          total: 129.5,
          paid: true,
          shipped_at: null,
          notes: "Leave the parcel with the neighbour at number 14 if nobody answers; the customer asked twice for a call before delivery, and asked that the courier not ring the bell after 21:00.",
        }}
        className="h-panel-md w-panel-md"
      />
      <JsonViewer aria-label="events" value={events} defaultExpandDepth={2} className="h-panel-md w-panel-md" />
      <JsonViewer
        aria-label="request"
        mode={mode}
        onModeChange={setMode}
        value={{ method: "POST", path: "/orders", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: { sku: "A-1", quantity: 3 } }}
        actions={<ToolbarButton>Run jq…</ToolbarButton>}
        className="h-panel-md w-panel-md"
      />
      <JsonViewer aria-label="broken value" text={'{"id": 1, "status": open}'} className="w-panel-sm" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Kbd

[kbd.json](kbd.json): A keyboard key or shortcut shown as text: a <kbd> in the code type role on an inset background, with KbdGroup for combinations.

Usage: Use Kbd in help text, menus and tooltips to show a key (Esc) or, with KbdGroup, a shortcut (Ctrl + K). Write the separator between the keys as text (+, then). Kbd shows a shortcut; it does not bind one. For a symbol (⌘, ⇧) add hidden text that names the key.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Parts: KbdGroup (data-slot kbd-group): Lines up the keys of one shortcut with their text separators, in text.caption and color.fg.muted.
- Props: children (ReactNode); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.border.subtle, color.fg.muted, font.sans, radius.sm, size.icon.xs, space.inline.xs, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: Renders <kbd>, which marks keyboard input; KbdGroup is an outer <kbd>, as HTML nests the keys of a combination. Screen readers read the key labels and the text separators; write "Ctrl", not an icon alone. A <kbd> takes no aria-label: give a symbol (⌘) visually hidden text (sr-only) and mark the symbol aria-hidden. Not focusable and not interactive; nothing to operate. color.fg.muted on color.bg.inset is contrast-checked as text by the token build.

Examples (KbdMinimal, KbdRealistic):

```tsx
import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from "@/components/ui/kbd";

/** The smallest useful Kbd: one key. */
export function KbdMinimal() {
  return <Kbd>Esc</Kbd>;
}

/** Shortcut hints in a query editor's help text: combinations, a symbol with a name, a sequence. */
export function KbdRealistic() {
  return (
    <ul className="flex flex-col gap-stack-xs text-body text-fg">
      <li className="flex items-center gap-inline-md">
        Run the query
        <KbdGroup>
          <Kbd>Ctrl</Kbd>+<Kbd>Enter</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
      </li>
      <li className="flex items-center gap-inline-md">
        Open the command palette
        <KbdGroup>
          <Kbd title="Command">
            <span aria-hidden="true">⌘</span>
            <span className="sr-only">Command</span>
          </Kbd>
          +<Kbd>K</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
      </li>
      <li className="flex items-center gap-inline-md">
        Go to a table
        <KbdGroup>
          <Kbd>G</Kbd>then<Kbd>T</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
      </li>
    </ul>
  );
}
```

### KeyValueEditor

[key-value-editor.json](key-value-editor.json): Edit a list of key and value pairs: message headers, labels, environment variables; rows added with Enter, removed with a button or Mod+Backspace, values in text or base64.

Usage: Use KeyValueEditor where the user writes pairs whose keys they choose: the Composer's headers (keyLabel="Name", valueEncodings=["text", "base64"], repeated names allowed), resource labels (allowDuplicates={false}). It is controlled: pass value and onChange. Enter in a key moves to its value; Enter in a value adds a row below; Mod+Backspace removes the row; focus follows. keySuggestions feeds a datalist. Duplicate keys (when not allowed), a value without a key and a value that is not base64 are marked invalid with a message; the app decides whether to block sending. Show pairs read-only with DescriptionList, or readOnly here to keep the columns.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Props: value (KeyValueEntry[]); onChange ((value: KeyValueEntry[]) => void); keySuggestions (string[]); allowDuplicates (boolean, default true); valueEncodings (("text" | "base64")[]); keyLabel (string, default "Key"); valueLabel (string, default "Value"); addLabel (string, default "Add"); readOnly (boolean, default false); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); aria-label (string, default "Key and value pairs"); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: invalid (data-invalid)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.layer-alt, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.fg, color.status.danger.stroke, font.sans, motion.duration.faster, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight
- Accessibility: The list is a group (role="group") with an accessible name; every input is labelled with its column and row ("Name 2", "Value 2"), and the column header is aria-hidden. Enter moves from a key to its value and adds a row from a value; Mod+Backspace removes the row (aria-keyshortcuts on the remove button); focus moves to the new row's key or to the previous row. Invalid inputs are aria-invalid and aria-describedby their message. The remove buttons are labelled "Remove row n"; the add button has visible text.

Examples (KeyValueEditorMinimal, KeyValueEditorRealistic):

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { KeyValueEditor, type KeyValueEntry } from "@/components/ui/key-value-editor";

/** The smallest useful KeyValueEditor: labels of a resource. */
export function KeyValueEditorMinimal() {
  const [labels, setLabels] = useState<KeyValueEntry[]>([{ key: "app", value: "orders" }]);
  return <KeyValueEditor aria-label="Labels" value={labels} onChange={setLabels} allowDuplicates={false} addLabel="Add label" />;
}

/** Message headers in the Composer: repeated names allowed, a binary value in base64, suggestions. */
export function KeyValueEditorRealistic() {
  const [headers, setHeaders] = useState<KeyValueEntry[]>([
    { key: "trace-id", value: "4bf92f3577b34da6", encoding: "text" },
    { key: "tag", value: "eu", encoding: "text" },
    { key: "tag", value: "priority", encoding: "text" },
    { key: "signature", value: "3q2+7w==", encoding: "base64" },
  ]);
  return (
    <KeyValueEditor
      aria-label="Headers"
      keyLabel="Name"
      value={headers}
      onChange={setHeaders}
      valueEncodings={["text", "base64"]}
      keySuggestions={["content-type", "trace-id", "tag", "correlation-id"]}
      addLabel="Add header"
    />
  );
}
```

### LogViewer

[log-viewer.json](log-viewer.json): Log lines as they arrive (container and pod logs, a Compose project's merged logs): appended through a ref with no React state per line, at most maxLines kept, virtualized rows, ANSI SGR colours and bold, italic and underline on the terminal.* roles, stdout and stderr marked, timestamps, follow, wrap, and search with Mod+F.

Usage: Use LogViewer for output that keeps coming: a container's or pod's logs, a build, a Compose project's services merged by time (streamColumn with a chart category per service). Lines never go through props: call ref.append(lines) as they arrive (each { ts?, stream?, text }, text with ANSI escapes as the process wrote them) and ref.clear() for a new run. Keep follow in the app's toolbar with onFollowChange: scrolling up stops following, scrolling back to the end or the footer's Follow resumes it. Give onDownload to offer the loaded lines as a file (the app saves it). Mod+F, F3 and Shift+F3 search the loaded lines; ref.openSearch() opens the bar from a button. Use Terminal for an interactive session, CodeBlock for a fixed snippet, JsonViewer for structured data.

- Wraps: no Base UI part
- Props: ref (Ref<LogViewerHandle>); maxLines (number, default 50000); follow (boolean); defaultFollow (boolean, default true); onFollowChange ((follow: boolean) => void); wrap (boolean, default false); timestamps (boolean, default true); formatTimestamp ((ts: string | number) => string); streamColors (Record<string, LogStreamColor>, default "{ stderr: \"danger\" }"); streamColumn (boolean, default false); onDownload ((text: string) => void); emptyText (ReactNode, default "No log lines yet."); aria-label (string, default "Log"); overscan (number, default 12); className (string)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible)
- Tokens: color.bg.layer, color.border.subtle, color.fg.muted, color.ring, color.ring-inner, font.mono, font.sans, radius.lg, ring.inner-width, ring.width, space.inline.sm, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, terminal.bg, terminal.fg, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, text.code-sm.leading, text.code-sm.size, text.code-sm.tracking, text.code-sm.weight
- Accessibility: The lines are role="log" with aria-live="off" (a busy log would flood a screen reader) and an accessible name; the scroller is the tab stop, so arrows, Page Up and Page Down scroll it and End follows again. Mod+F opens a search bar (role="search") whose count is announced politely; Enter and F3 go to the next match, Shift with them to the previous one, Escape closes it and returns focus to the log. Colour is never the only mark: stderr rows also carry data-stream, the stream column names the stream, and every ANSI colour reads at 4.5:1 on terminal.bg (the token build checks each pair). Focus shows the double ring: ring.width in color.ring around ring.inner-width in color.ring-inner.

Examples (LogViewerMinimal, LogViewerRealistic):

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { LogViewer, type LogLine, type LogViewerHandle } from "@/components/ui/log-viewer";
import { ToggleButton } from "@/components/ui/toggle-button";

const ESC = "\u001b";

/** The smallest useful LogViewer: a few lines appended through its ref. */
export function LogViewerMinimal() {
  const ref = useRef<LogViewerHandle>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    ref.current?.append([{ text: "listening on :8080" }, { text: "GET /health 200 1ms" }]);
  }, []);
  return <LogViewer ref={ref} aria-label="api logs" timestamps={false} className="h-panel-xs" />;
}

/** A web service's log as Docker sends it: timestamps, stderr marked, ANSI levels. */
const SAMPLE: LogLine[] = [
  { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:01.120458Z", stream: "stdout", text: `${ESC}[32mINFO${ESC}[0m  server listening on :8080` },
  { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:01.402113Z", stream: "stdout", text: `${ESC}[32mINFO${ESC}[0m  connected to ${ESC}[1mpostgres${ESC}[22m at db:5432` },
  { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:02.981374Z", stream: "stdout", text: `${ESC}[36mDEBUG${ESC}[0m GET /api/orders?status=PAID ${ESC}[2m(12 ms)${ESC}[0m` },
  { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:03.004921Z", stream: "stderr", text: `${ESC}[33mWARN${ESC}[0m  slow query: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' (842 ms)` },
  { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:04.551007Z", stream: "stderr", text: `${ESC}[1;31mERROR${ESC}[0m payment provider timed out for ${ESC}[4mord-1042${ESC}[24m after 3 attempts` },
  { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:05.000000Z", stream: "stdout", text: `${ESC}[35mTRACE${ESC}[0m retry scheduled ${ESC}[3min 30 s${ESC}[23m` },
  { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:05.120000Z", stream: "stdout", text: `${ESC}[34mINFO${ESC}[0m  ${ESC}[7m maintenance ${ESC}[27m window starts at 09:00` },
];

/** A container's Logs tab: follow, wrap and timestamps in a toolbar, more lines on demand, download. */
export function LogViewerRealistic() {
  const ref = useRef<LogViewerHandle>(null);
  const [follow, setFollow] = useState(true);
  const [wrap, setWrap] = useState(false);
  const [timestamps, setTimestamps] = useState(true);
  const [downloaded, setDownloaded] = useState<number | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    ref.current?.append(SAMPLE);
  }, []);
  const more = () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    ref.current?.append(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => ({ ts: now + i, stream: i % 7 === 6 ? "stderr" : "stdout", text: `GET /api/orders/${1000 + i} 200 ${(i % 5) + 1} ms` })));
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-stack-sm">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-inline-sm">
        <ToggleButton size="small" pressed={follow} onPressedChange={setFollow}>
          Follow
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton size="small" pressed={wrap} onPressedChange={setWrap}>
          Wrap
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton size="small" pressed={timestamps} onPressedChange={setTimestamps}>
          Timestamps
        </ToggleButton>
        <Button appearance="secondary" size="small" onClick={more}>
          Twenty more lines
        </Button>
        <Button appearance="subtle" size="small" onClick={() => ref.current?.openSearch()}>
          Search
        </Button>
      </div>
      <LogViewer
        ref={ref}
        aria-label="orders-api logs"
        follow={follow}
        onFollowChange={setFollow}
        wrap={wrap}
        timestamps={timestamps}
        onDownload={(text) => setDownloaded(text.split("\n").length)}
        className="h-panel-sm"
      />
      {downloaded === null ? null : <p className="text-caption-1 text-fg-muted">Downloaded {downloaded} lines.</p>}
      <LogViewer
        aria-label="shop project logs"
        streamColumn
        streamColors={{ web: "cat-1", worker: "cat-2", db: "cat-3" }}
        ref={(handle) => {
          if (handle && handle.lines().length === 0)
            handle.append([
              { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:01Z", stream: "db", text: "database system is ready to accept connections" },
              { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:02Z", stream: "web", text: "listening on :8080" },
              { ts: "2026-11-20T08:00:03Z", stream: "worker", text: "picked up job 17" },
            ]);
        }}
        className="h-panel-xs"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Menubar

[menubar.json](menubar.json): A row of menus, as at the top of a desktop window, on Base UI's Menubar: titles that open DropdownMenu-style menus (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus), moving between menus with the arrow keys or the pointer once one is open.

Usage: Use Menubar for an application's menu row in a web build, where the window has no native menu: File, Query, View, Help. Compose it as Menubar > MenubarMenu (one per menu) > MenubarTrigger (the title) + MenubarContent > MenubarItem (MenubarShortcut at the end; danger for a destructive one), MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarRadioGroup with MenubarRadioItem, MenubarGroup with MenubarLabel, MenubarSeparator, MenubarSub > MenubarSubTrigger + MenubarSubContent. Keep the commands also in the CommandPalette. On the desktop prefer the native menu; for one menu behind a button use DropdownMenu; for site navigation (links) use NavigationMenu.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/menubar
- Parts: MenubarTrigger (data-slot menubar-trigger): A menu's title in the row (role="menuitem", aria-haspopup="menu"), in type.label; color.interactive.hover while hovered or open.; MenubarContent (data-slot menubar-content): The portal, the positioner under the title and the menu.; MenubarItem (data-slot menubar-item): role="menuitem"; color.interactive.hover while highlighted; data-danger for a destructive one.; MenubarCheckboxItem (data-slot menubar-checkbox-item): role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and a check mark.; MenubarRadioGroup (data-slot menubar-radio-group): role="group" holding the radio items; value and onValueChange.; MenubarRadioItem (data-slot menubar-radio-item): role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked and a dot.; MenubarGroup (data-slot menubar-group): role="group", named by its MenubarLabel.; MenubarLabel (data-slot menubar-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; MenubarSeparator (data-slot menubar-separator): role="separator", a 1 px line in color.border.default.; MenubarShortcut (data-slot menubar-shortcut): The shortcut at the end of an item, in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; MenubarSubTrigger (data-slot menubar-sub-trigger): An item that opens a submenu (aria-haspopup), with a chevron; color.interactive.hover while its submenu is open.; MenubarSubContent (data-slot menubar-sub-content): The submenu's popup, beside its trigger.
- Props: orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal"); loopFocus (boolean, default true); modal (boolean, default true); open (boolean); onOpenChange ((open: boolean, details) => void); danger (boolean, default false); closeOnClick (boolean, default true); disabled (boolean, default false); checked (boolean); value (unknown); className (string)
- States: hover (hover), focus-visible (focus-visible), open (data-starting-style), closing (data-ending-style), highlighted (data-highlighted), submenu-open (data-popup-open), danger (data-danger), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.subtle-fg, color.bg.layer, color.bg.overlay, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.bg, color.status.danger.fg, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.md, size.panel.xs, space.inline.lg, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.caption-1-strong.leading, text.caption-1-strong.size, text.caption-1-strong.tracking, text.caption-1-strong.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The row is role="menubar"; each title is role="menuitem" with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; each popup is role="menu" of menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items. One title is in the tab order; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between titles (wrapping), Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens a menu with its first item highlighted; while a menu is open ArrowLeft and ArrowRight open the neighbouring menu; Escape closes and returns focus to the title. Inside a menu: arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses; ArrowRight on a sub-trigger opens its submenu. Disabled items stay reachable but have aria-disabled and cannot be chosen. Once one menu is open, moving the pointer over another title opens that menu. Titles have the double focus ring; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the menus' slide and fade off. Every command is also in the CommandPalette with its shortcut.

Examples (MenubarMinimal, MenubarRealistic):

```tsx
import {
  Menubar,
  MenubarCheckboxItem,
  MenubarContent,
  MenubarGroup,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarLabel,
  MenubarMenu,
  MenubarRadioGroup,
  MenubarRadioItem,
  MenubarSeparator,
  MenubarShortcut,
  MenubarSub,
  MenubarSubContent,
  MenubarSubTrigger,
  MenubarTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/menubar";

/** The smallest useful Menubar: two menus. */
export function MenubarMinimal() {
  return (
    <Menubar>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>New query tab</MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem>Close tab</MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>Help</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>About DBee</MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
    </Menubar>
  );
}

/**
 * A web build's menu row (the desktop keeps the native one): shortcuts, a recent-files submenu,
 * view options as checkbox and radio items, a disabled and a destructive action.
 */
export function MenubarRealistic() {
  return (
    <Menubar>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>
            New query tab <MenubarShortcut>Alt+Shift+T</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem>
            Add connection <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+Alt+N</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarSub>
            <MenubarSubTrigger>Open recent</MenubarSubTrigger>
            <MenubarSubContent>
              <MenubarItem>orders-by-region.sql</MenubarItem>
              <MenubarItem>vacuum-report.sql</MenubarItem>
            </MenubarSubContent>
          </MenubarSub>
          <MenubarSeparator />
          <MenubarItem>
            Export result <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+Shift+S</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem danger>
            Close tab <MenubarShortcut>Alt+Shift+W</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>Query</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarItem>
            Run statement <MenubarShortcut>Ctrl+Enter</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
          <MenubarItem disabled>
            Cancel <MenubarShortcut>Shift+Escape</MenubarShortcut>
          </MenubarItem>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarCheckboxItem defaultChecked>Sidebar</MenubarCheckboxItem>
          <MenubarCheckboxItem>Status bar</MenubarCheckboxItem>
          <MenubarSeparator />
          <MenubarGroup>
            <MenubarLabel>Density</MenubarLabel>
            <MenubarRadioGroup defaultValue="compact">
              <MenubarRadioItem value="compact">Compact</MenubarRadioItem>
              <MenubarRadioItem value="comfortable">Comfortable</MenubarRadioItem>
            </MenubarRadioGroup>
          </MenubarGroup>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
    </Menubar>
  );
}
```

### MultiSelect

[multi-select.json](multi-select.json): Several choices from a list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox with multiple: each chosen item is a removable chip before the input, with Combobox's popup and items, in three sizes.

Usage: Use MultiSelect when the user picks any number of values from a list (columns, privileges, schemas, tags). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items and a function child that renders each one as a ComboboxItem, as for Combobox; value is an array. Items that are { value, label } objects show their label on the chip; for ids from a Combobox.createItems collection pass itemToStringLabel. The list stays open after each choice; Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field. For one value use Combobox or Select; for a few always-visible options, a CheckboxGroup. Appearance outline is the default; underline for dense or inline forms, filled-darker on white surfaces, filled-lighter on grey ones. The old sizes sm/md/lg still work for one release.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/combobox
- appearance: outline, underline, filled-darker, filled-lighter
- size: small, medium, large
- Props: items (Item[] | { value, items: Item[] }[] | ComboboxItemCollection); value (Value[]); defaultValue (Value[]); onValueChange ((value: Value[], details) => void); itemToStringLabel ((value: Value) => string); placeholder (string); emptyMessage (ReactNode, default "\"No results.\""); status (ReactNode); appearance ("outline" | "underline" | "filled-darker" | "filled-lighter", default "outline"); size ("small" | "medium" | "large", default "medium"); size (sm, md, lg) ("sm" | "md" | "lg", deprecated: use small, medium or large); clearLabel (string, default "\"Clear all\""); removeLabel ((label: string) => string, default "label => `Remove ${label}`"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (has-[input:focus-visible]), has values (has-[[data-slot=multi-select-chip]]), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), hover (hover), chip highlighted (data-highlighted), no value (not-data-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.bg.layer-alt, color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.control-bottom, color.border.disabled, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.neutral.subtle-bg, color.neutral.subtle-fg, color.ring, color.ring-inner, color.status.danger.border, color.status.danger.stroke, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.inner-width, ring.width, shadow.focus-underline, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.md, size.icon.xs, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.xs, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-2.leading, text.body-2.size, text.body-2.tracking, text.body-2.weight, text.caption-1.leading, text.caption-1.size, text.caption-1.tracking, text.caption-1.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: The input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" with aria-multiselectable, and chosen items have aria-selected and a check mark. Typing filters; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight, Enter adds or removes the highlighted item and the list stays open. Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip; ArrowLeft at the start of the input moves onto the chips, where Backspace or Delete removes one. Each chip is named by its text and its remove button by removeLabel ("Remove SELECT"); the clear button is named by clearLabel. The chevron is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology. Chips use color.neutral.subtle with color.neutral.subtle-fg (4.5:1), and the highlighted chip color.interactive.selected, with the double focus ring as well. The popup takes the frame's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>.

Examples (MultiSelectMinimal, MultiSelectRealistic):

```tsx
import { ComboboxItem } from "@/components/ui/combobox";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { MultiSelect } from "@/components/ui/multi-select";

const columns = ["id", "customer_id", "status", "total", "created_at", "updated_at"];

/** The smallest useful MultiSelect: labelled columns, two already chosen. */
export function MultiSelectMinimal() {
  return (
    <Field className="w-full">
      <FieldLabel>Columns</FieldLabel>
      <MultiSelect items={columns} defaultValue={["id", "status"]} placeholder="Search columns">
        {(column: string) => (
          <ComboboxItem key={column} value={column}>
            {column}
          </ComboboxItem>
        )}
      </MultiSelect>
    </Field>
  );
}

interface Privilege {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

const privileges: Privilege[] = [
  { value: "select", label: "SELECT" },
  { value: "insert", label: "INSERT" },
  { value: "update", label: "UPDATE" },
  { value: "delete", label: "DELETE" },
  { value: "truncate", label: "TRUNCATE" },
];

const schemas = ["public", "analytics", "audit", "billing", "inventory"];

/**
 * A grant: privileges as `{ value, label }` objects, schemas with an empty-state message, tags
 * nobody has added yet (invalid), owners the policy fixes, and the small and large sizes.
 */
export function MultiSelectRealistic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-stack-md">
      <Field name="privileges">
        <FieldLabel>Privileges</FieldLabel>
        <MultiSelect items={privileges} defaultValue={[privileges[0]!, privileges[1]!]} placeholder="Add privileges">
          {(privilege: Privilege) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={privilege.value} value={privilege}>
              {privilege.label}
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </MultiSelect>
        <FieldDescription>Backspace removes the last one.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="schemas">
        <FieldLabel>Schemas</FieldLabel>
        <MultiSelect items={schemas} placeholder="Search schemas" emptyMessage="No schema matches." size="small" appearance="filled-lighter">
          {(schema: string) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={schema} value={schema}>
              {schema}
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </MultiSelect>
      </Field>
      <Field name="tags" invalid>
        <FieldLabel>Tags</FieldLabel>
        <MultiSelect items={["production", "pii", "reporting"]} placeholder="Add tags">
          {(tag: string) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={tag} value={tag}>
              {tag}
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </MultiSelect>
        <FieldError>Add at least one tag.</FieldError>
      </Field>
      <Field name="owners" disabled>
        <FieldLabel>Owners</FieldLabel>
        <MultiSelect items={["dba", "platform"]} defaultValue={["dba"]}>
          {(owner: string) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={owner} value={owner}>
              {owner}
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </MultiSelect>
        <FieldDescription>Set by the workspace administrator.</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Field name="notify">
        <FieldLabel>Notify</FieldLabel>
        <MultiSelect items={["on-call", "data-team", "security"]} defaultValue={["on-call"]} size="large" appearance="underline">
          {(team: string) => (
            <ComboboxItem key={team} value={team}>
              {team}
            </ComboboxItem>
          )}
        </MultiSelect>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### NavigationMenu

[navigation-menu.json](navigation-menu.json): Site or app navigation with panels of links, on Base UI's NavigationMenu: a <nav> row of titles that open panels in one shared popup, links with descriptions and a current-page mark, and plain links in the row.

Usage: Use NavigationMenu for the top navigation of a web build or a docs site, where entries group several destinations: Workspace (connections, saved queries, history), Administration. Compose it as NavigationMenu > NavigationMenuList > NavigationMenuItem (value) with a NavigationMenuTrigger and a NavigationMenuContent of NavigationMenuLinks (href; active for the current page), or a NavigationMenuLink straight in the row with className={navigationMenuTriggerStyle}. It navigates; for actions use Menubar or DropdownMenu; for an app's side navigation use Sidebar; for views of one place, Tabs.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/navigation-menu
- Parts: NavigationMenuList (data-slot navigation-menu-list): The row of entries, a <ul>.; NavigationMenuItem (data-slot navigation-menu-item): One entry, an <li>.; NavigationMenuTrigger (data-slot navigation-menu-trigger): A title button with aria-expanded and a chevron; color.interactive.hover while hovered or open.; NavigationMenuContent (data-slot navigation-menu-content): An entry's panel of links, size.panel.md wide, shown in the shared popup.; NavigationMenuLink (data-slot navigation-menu-link): A link: a row with a title and a muted description in a panel; data-active and aria-current="page" when active.
- Props: value (string | null); onValueChange ((value, details) => void); orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal"); delay (number, default 50); href (string); active (boolean, default false); className (string)
- States: open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), leaving (data-ending-style), hover (hover), active (data-active), focus-visible (focus-visible)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.border.subtle, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.ring, color.ring-inner, elevation.flyout.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.duration.faster, motion.duration.normal, motion.easing.accelerate-mid, motion.easing.decelerate-mid, motion.easing.easy-ease, radius.lg, radius.md, ring.inner-width, ring.width, size.control.md, size.icon.md, size.panel.md, space.control.x, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.stack.xs, text.body-1-strong.leading, text.body-1-strong.size, text.body-1-strong.tracking, text.body-1-strong.weight, text.body-1.leading, text.body-1.size, text.body-1.tracking, text.body-1.weight, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, z.popover
- Accessibility: A <nav> landmark holding a list; triggers are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls; panels hold ordinary links, the current one with aria-current="page". Tab moves along the row; Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens a trigger's panel and Tab moves into its links; ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between entries; Escape closes the panel and returns focus to its trigger. Hovering a trigger opens its panel after a short delay; moving to another trigger switches panels in the same popup. Links in the row look like triggers but stay links (Enter follows them). prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the fades and the chevron's turn off. The popup takes the row's theme and density and sits at z.popover.

Examples (NavigationMenuMinimal, NavigationMenuRealistic):

```tsx
import {
  NavigationMenu,
  NavigationMenuContent,
  NavigationMenuItem,
  NavigationMenuLink,
  NavigationMenuList,
  NavigationMenuTrigger,
  navigationMenuTriggerStyle,
} from "@/components/ui/navigation-menu";

/** The smallest useful NavigationMenu: one panel of links and one link in the row. */
export function NavigationMenuMinimal() {
```
