The outline of a info alert or banner, on color.status.info.bg. Not the outline of an invalid field, which must reach 3:1: use color.status.danger.stroke.
- `color.backdrop.glow-1` (semantic color): `--by-color-backdrop-glow-1`. Values: light oklch(0.93 0.0344 282.5), dark oklch(0.32 0.0743 282.5). Colour of the backdrop's first glow, at the top left of the app. The canvas colour unless the theme gives the backdrop glows (Aurora: a light tint of the brand). Not painted on its own: gradient.backdrop draws it. Not for surfaces or text.
- `color.backdrop.glow-2` (semantic color): `--by-color-backdrop-glow-2`. Values: light oklch(0.955 0.0154 190), dark oklch(0.32 0.0495 190). Colour of the backdrop's second glow, at the right edge of the app. The canvas colour unless the theme gives the backdrop glows (Aurora: a light aqua). Not painted on its own: gradient.backdrop draws it. Not for surfaces or text.
- `color.bg.layer` (semantic color): `--by-color-bg-layer`. Tailwind `*-layer` (--color-layer). Values: light oklch(1 0 0 / 0.72), dark oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05). Translucent surfaces on the backdrop: cards, panels, toolbars, and the fill of secondary buttons. The backdrop shows through (72 % white in light, 5 % in dark). Not for floating layers (use elevation.flyout or elevation.dialog) and not on an opaque surface where nothing shows through: use color.bg.surface.
- `color.bg.layer-alt` (semantic color): `--by-color-bg-layer-alt`. Tailwind `*-layer-alt` (--color-layer-alt). Values: light oklch(1 0 0), dark oklch(1 0 0 / 0.06). The fill of text fields, selects and segmented tracks on a layer, and every other row of a striped table: one step brighter than color.bg.layer. Not for cards or panels: use color.bg.layer. Not a hover state: use color.interactive.hover.
- `color.border.subtle` (semantic color): `--by-color-border-subtle`. Tailwind `*-border-subtle` (--color-border-subtle). Values: light oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08), dark oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08). Hairline outline of controls, flyouts and separators on translucent layers: 8 % black or white, so it reads on any backdrop. Not the only cue that identifies a text field (far below 3:1): add color.border.control-bottom. On opaque surfaces color.border.default also works.
- `color.border.control-bottom` (semantic color): `--by-color-border-control-bottom`. Tailwind `*-border-control-bottom` (--color-border-control-bottom). Values: light oklch(0 0 0 / 0.45), dark oklch(1 0 0 / 0.55). The darker bottom edge of text fields, selects and other inputs, drawn over color.border.subtle: the stroke that makes a field reach 3:1 on its layer. Not on buttons (use color.border.control-bottom-subtle) and not as a whole outline (use color.border.subtle around the field).
- `color.border.control-bottom-subtle` (semantic color): `--by-color-border-control-bottom-subtle`. Tailwind `*-border-control-bottom-subtle` (--color-border-control-bottom-subtle). Values: light oklch(0 0 0 / 0.18), dark oklch(1 0 0 / 0.04). The slightly different bottom edge of buttons and other raised controls, which reads as depth. Not on text fields, whose bottom stroke must reach 3:1: use color.border.control-bottom. Never the only thing that identifies a control.
- `color.border.focus-underline` (semantic color): `--by-color-border-focus-underline`. Tailwind `*-border-focus-underline` (--color-border-focus-underline). Values: light oklch(0.5656 0.2473 282.5), dark oklch(0.82 0.0925 282.5). The 2 px underline of a focused text field, in the accent colour (shadow.focus-underline draws it). Not the focus indicator of buttons and other controls: use the double ring (color.ring outside color.ring-inner).
- `color.ring-inner` (semantic color): `--by-color-ring-inner`. Tailwind `*-ring-inner` (--color-ring-inner). Values: light oklch(1 0 0), dark oklch(0 0 0). The inner stroke of the double focus ring, between the control and color.ring, so the ring reads on any fill (white in light, black in dark). Not a focus indicator on its own: it is always drawn with color.ring outside it.

### size (roles)

- `size.scrollbar` (semantic dimension): `--by-size-scrollbar`. Tailwind `*-scrollbar` (--spacing-scrollbar). Values: comfortable 10px, compact 8px. The thickness of a native scrollbar in WebKit (Safari, the Tauri webview on Linux and macOS); the thumb is drawn border.width.2 inside it. Chrome and Firefox take scrollbar-width: thin instead. Not for ScrollArea's overlay bars, which use size.track. Not for slider tracks.
- `size.control.xs` (semantic dimension): `--by-size-control-xs`. Tailwind `*-control-xs` (--spacing-control-xs). Values: comfortable 20px, compact 18px. Height of the smallest controls: inline tags, icon buttons inside a row. Not a touch target; not for primary actions.
- `size.control.sm` (semantic dimension): `--by-size-control-sm`. Tailwind `*-control-sm` (--spacing-control-sm). Values: comfortable 24px, compact 22px. Height of small controls (Fluent 2's small, 24 px when comfortable) and of dense rows (toolbars, grid rows). Not for forms a user fills in at length: use size.control.md.
- `size.control.md` (semantic dimension): `--by-size-control-md`. Tailwind `*-control-md` (--spacing-control-md). Values: comfortable 32px, compact 28px. Height of standard controls: buttons, inputs, selects (Fluent 2's medium, 32 px when comfortable). Not a fixed pixel value: never hard-code 32px, the density mode changes it.
- `size.control.lg` (semantic dimension): `--by-size-control-lg`. Tailwind `*-control-lg` (--spacing-control-lg). Values: comfortable 40px, compact 34px. Height of large controls (Fluent 2's large, 40 px when comfortable): the main call to action, touch-first layouts. Not inside dense tools such as grids and toolbars.

### radius (roles)

- `radius.none` (semantic dimension): `--by-radius-none`. Values: 0. Square corners: table cells, full-bleed panels, dividers. Not for controls and containers, which follow the radius seed: use radius.md or radius.lg.
- `radius.xs` (semantic dimension): `--by-radius-xs`. Tailwind `*-xs` (--radius-xs). Values: 1px. The smallest rounding: focus outlines on inline text, code chips, scrollbar thumbs. Not for controls: use radius.sm or radius.md.
- `radius.sm` (semantic dimension): `--by-radius-sm`. Tailwind `*-sm` (--radius-sm). Values: 3px. Small elements: checkboxes, tags, extra-small controls. Not for standard controls: use radius.md.
- `radius.md` (semantic dimension): `--by-radius-md`. Tailwind `*-md` (--radius-md). Values: 4px. Standard controls: buttons, inputs, menu items. Not for containers: use radius.lg.
- `radius.lg` (semantic dimension): `--by-radius-lg`. Tailwind `*-lg` (--radius-lg). Values: 8px. Containers: cards, popovers, dialogs. Not for controls inside those containers: use radius.md.
- `radius.xl` (semantic dimension): `--by-radius-xl`. Tailwind `*-xl` (--radius-xl). Values: 8px. Large containers: sheets, drawers, big cards. Not for controls and not for small containers: use radius.md or radius.lg.
- `radius.full` (semantic dimension): `--by-radius-full`. Values: 9999px. Pills and circles: avatars, switches, badges, round icon buttons. Not for rectangles that happen to be small: use radius.sm.

### font (roles)

- `font.sans` (semantic fontFamily): `--by-font-sans`. Tailwind `*-sans` (--font-sans). Values: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif. All interface text: the system's Segoe UI Variable where it is installed, else the vendored Inter (fonts/fonts.css). Not for code, identifiers or tabular data that must align: use font.mono.
- `font.mono` (semantic fontFamily): `--by-font-mono`. Tailwind `*-mono` (--font-mono). Values: "Cascadia Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace. Code, SQL, identifiers, and grid cells that must align: the system's Cascadia Mono where it is installed, else the vendored JetBrains Mono. Not for labels or prose.

### shadow (roles)

- `shadow.raised` (semantic shadow): `--by-shadow-raised`. Tailwind `*-raised` (--shadow-raised). Values: light 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 1px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), dark 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05). The lift of buttons and cards one step above their background. Not for popovers or dialogs, which need a deeper shadow.
- `shadow.0` (semantic shadow): `--by-shadow-0`. Values: light 0 0 0 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), dark 0 0 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05). No shadow: a surface that sits flat on the canvas. Light themes use soft black shadows; dark themes use a lighter surface and a hairline ring instead. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.raised, elevation.overlay) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `shadow.1` (semantic shadow): `--by-shadow-1`. Values: light 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 1px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), dark 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05). The faintest lift: buttons and cards one step above their background. Light themes use soft black shadows; dark themes use a lighter surface and a hairline ring instead. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.raised, elevation.overlay) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `shadow.2` (semantic shadow): `--by-shadow-2`. Values: light 0 2px 4px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), dark 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05), 0 2px 4px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2). A clear lift: sticky headers, hovered cards, toasts. Light themes use soft black shadows; dark themes use a lighter surface and a hairline ring instead. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.raised, elevation.overlay) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `shadow.3` (semantic shadow): `--by-shadow-3`. Values: light 0 4px 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), dark 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05), 0 4px 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2). A floating layer: popovers, dropdown menus, tooltips. Light themes use soft black shadows; dark themes use a lighter surface and a hairline ring instead. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.raised, elevation.overlay) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `shadow.4` (semantic shadow): `--by-shadow-4`. Values: light 0 8px 16px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), dark 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 16px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3). A large floating layer: command palettes and menus with a lot of content. Light themes use soft black shadows; dark themes use a lighter surface and a hairline ring instead. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.raised, elevation.overlay) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `shadow.5` (semantic shadow): `--by-shadow-5`. Values: light 0 16px 32px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.15), 0 8px 12px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), dark 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1), 0 16px 32px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3). The deepest shadow: modal dialogs and drawers. Light themes use soft black shadows; dark themes use a lighter surface and a hairline ring instead. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.raised, elevation.overlay) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `shadow.focus-underline` (semantic shadow): `--by-shadow-focus-underline`. Tailwind `*-focus-underline` (--shadow-focus-underline). Values: light inset 0 -2px 0 0 oklch(0.5656 0.2473 282.5), dark inset 0 -2px 0 0 oklch(0.82 0.0925 282.5). Draws the 2 px accent underline of a focused text field inside its box (inset 0 -2px 0), over its bottom stroke. Not for buttons or a whole-box focus ring: use the double ring (ring.color and ring.inner-color).

### elevation (roles)

- `elevation.flat.shadow` (semantic shadow): `--by-elevation-flat-shadow`. Values: light 0 0 0 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), dark 0 0 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05). Shadow of the flat elevation. Cards, panels and table bodies that sit on the canvas without a lift. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for anything that floats above other content.
- `elevation.flat.border` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-flat-border`. Values: light oklch(0.875 0.0048 275), dark oklch(0.32 0.0054 275). Hairline border of the flat elevation: in dark themes it carries most of the separation. Cards, panels and table bodies that sit on the canvas without a lift. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for anything that floats above other content.
- `elevation.flat.bg` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-flat-bg`. Values: light oklch(1 0 0), dark oklch(0.25 0.0108 275). Surface colour of the flat elevation. Cards, panels and table bodies that sit on the canvas without a lift. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for anything that floats above other content.
- `elevation.raised.shadow` (semantic shadow): `--by-elevation-raised-shadow`. Values: light 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 1px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), dark 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05). Shadow of the raised elevation. Content one step above its surroundings: buttons, hovered cards, sticky bars. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for popovers and menus: use elevation.overlay.
- `elevation.raised.border` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-raised-border`. Values: light oklch(0.875 0.0048 275), dark oklch(0.32 0.0054 275). Hairline border of the raised elevation: in dark themes it carries most of the separation. Content one step above its surroundings: buttons, hovered cards, sticky bars. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for popovers and menus: use elevation.overlay.
- `elevation.raised.bg` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-raised-bg`. Values: light oklch(1 0 0), dark oklch(0.25 0.0108 275). Surface colour of the raised elevation. Content one step above its surroundings: buttons, hovered cards, sticky bars. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for popovers and menus: use elevation.overlay.
- `elevation.overlay.shadow` (semantic shadow): `--by-elevation-overlay-shadow`. Tailwind `*-overlay` (--shadow-overlay). Values: light 0 4px 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), dark 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05), 0 4px 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2). Shadow of the overlay elevation. Layers that float above the page and close on an outside click: popovers, dropdown menus, tooltips, the command palette. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for dialogs that block the page: use elevation.modal.
- `elevation.overlay.border` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-overlay-border`. Values: light oklch(0.875 0.0048 275), dark oklch(0.32 0.0054 275). Hairline border of the overlay elevation: in dark themes it carries most of the separation. Layers that float above the page and close on an outside click: popovers, dropdown menus, tooltips, the command palette. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for dialogs that block the page: use elevation.modal.
- `elevation.overlay.bg` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-overlay-bg`. Values: light oklch(1 0 0), dark oklch(0.28 0.0132 275). Surface colour of the overlay elevation. Layers that float above the page and close on an outside click: popovers, dropdown menus, tooltips, the command palette. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for dialogs that block the page: use elevation.modal.
- `elevation.modal.shadow` (semantic shadow): `--by-elevation-modal-shadow`. Tailwind `*-modal` (--shadow-modal). Values: light 0 16px 32px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.15), 0 8px 12px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1), dark 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1), 0 16px 32px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3). Shadow of the modal elevation. The top layer, over a scrim: dialogs, alert dialogs, drawers and sheets. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for anything that does not block the page.
- `elevation.modal.border` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-modal-border`. Values: light oklch(0.875 0.0048 275), dark oklch(0.32 0.0054 275). Hairline border of the modal elevation: in dark themes it carries most of the separation. The top layer, over a scrim: dialogs, alert dialogs, drawers and sheets. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for anything that does not block the page.
- `elevation.modal.bg` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-modal-bg`. Values: light oklch(1 0 0), dark oklch(0.28 0.0132 275). Surface colour of the modal elevation. The top layer, over a scrim: dialogs, alert dialogs, drawers and sheets. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for anything that does not block the page.
- `elevation.layer.shadow` (semantic shadow): `--by-elevation-layer-shadow`. Tailwind `*-layer` (--shadow-layer). Values: light 0 2px 4px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04), dark 0 0 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05). Shadow of the layer elevation. Cards and panels laid on the backdrop: a translucent fill, a hairline and (light only) a faint shadow. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for anything that floats: use elevation.flyout or elevation.dialog.
- `elevation.layer.border` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-layer-border`. Values: light oklch(0 0 0 / 0.06), dark oklch(1 0 0 / 0.07). Hairline border of the layer elevation. Cards and panels laid on the backdrop: a translucent fill, a hairline and (light only) a faint shadow. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for anything that floats: use elevation.flyout or elevation.dialog.
- `elevation.layer.bg` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-layer-bg`. Values: light oklch(1 0 0 / 0.72), dark oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05). Surface colour of the layer elevation. Cards and panels laid on the backdrop: a translucent fill, a hairline and (light only) a faint shadow. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for anything that floats: use elevation.flyout or elevation.dialog.
- `elevation.flyout.shadow` (semantic shadow): `--by-elevation-flyout-shadow`. Tailwind `*-flyout` (--shadow-flyout). Values: light 0 8px 16px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12), dark 0 8px 16px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.26), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4). Shadow of the flyout elevation. Layers that float over the page and close on an outside click, in the layered look: menus, popovers, select and combobox lists, tooltips, toasts. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for dialogs that block the page: use elevation.dialog.
- `elevation.flyout.border` (semantic color): `--by-elevation-flyout-border`. Values: light oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08), dark oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08). Hairline border of the flyout elevation. Layers that float over the page and close on an outside click, in the layered look: menus, popovers, select and combobox lists, tooltips, toasts. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for dialogs that block the page: use elevation.dialog.

Layers that float over the page and close on an outside click, in the layered look: menus, popovers, select and combobox lists, tooltips, toasts. Use the three tokens of the role together (shadow, border, bg). Not for dialogs that block the page: use elevation.dialog.

### ring (roles)

- `ring.width` (semantic dimension): `--by-ring-width`. Values: 2px. Thickness of the focus ring drawn around any focused element (the high-contrast preset makes it thicker). Not a border width: use border.width.*.
- `ring.offset` (semantic dimension): `--by-ring-offset`. Values: 2px. The gap between a focused element and its focus ring, so the ring never hides the element's own border. Not for spacing between elements: use space.gap.*.
- `ring.color` (semantic color): `--by-ring-color`. Values: light oklch(0 0 0), dark oklch(1 0 0). Colour of the focus ring: outline: var(--by-ring-width) solid var(--by-ring-color). Not a selection or accent colour: use color.interactive.selected or color.accent.bg.
- `ring.inner-width` (semantic dimension): `--by-ring-inner-width`. Values: 1px. Thickness of the inner stroke of the double focus ring (ring.inner-color), inside the ring.width of ring.color: outline for the outer stroke, box-shadow for the inner one. Not a border width: use border.width.*.
- `ring.inner-color` (semantic color): `--by-ring-inner-color`. Values: light oklch(1 0 0), dark oklch(0 0 0). Colour of the inner stroke of the double focus ring: box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--by-ring-inner-width) var(--by-ring-inner-color), with the outline in ring.color outside it. Not a border or a selection colour, and not without the outer ring.

### gradient (roles)

- `gradient.backdrop` (semantic gradient): `--by-gradient-backdrop`. Values: light radial-gradient(1100px 700px at 8% 0%, oklch(0.93 0.0344 282.5) 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(1000px 800px at 100% 35%, oklch(0.955 0.0154 190) 0%, transparent 60%), linear-gradient(oklch(0.975 0.006 275), oklch(0.975 0.006 275)), dark radial-gradient(1100px 700px at 8% 0%, oklch(0.32 0.0743 282.5) 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(1000px 800px at 100% 35%, oklch(0.32 0.0495 190) 0%, transparent 60%), linear-gradient(oklch(0.21 0.0084 275), oklch(0.21 0.0084 275)). The app background of the layered look, painted once on the app root (background or background-image: var(--by-gradient-backdrop), or the bg-(image:--by-gradient-backdrop) utility): the two backdrop glows over the canvas colour, under every translucent layer. Where the glows are the canvas colour it shows a flat canvas. Not behind a single card or control, and not where a colour is needed: tools without gradients (Figma, Monaco) read its solid colour, color.bg.canvas unless the theme changes it.

### depth (roles)

- `depth.2` (semantic shadow): `--by-depth-2`. Values: light 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12), dark 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.26), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4). Fluent depth 2: the faintest lift: a control or card that sits just above its layer. A key and an ambient shadow; dark themes keep both, darker. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.layer, elevation.flyout, elevation.dialog) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `depth.4` (semantic shadow): `--by-depth-4`. Values: light 0 2px 4px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12), dark 0 2px 4px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.26), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4). Fluent depth 4: a card that is hovered or dragged. A key and an ambient shadow; dark themes keep both, darker. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.layer, elevation.flyout, elevation.dialog) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `depth.8` (semantic shadow): `--by-depth-8`. Values: light 0 4px 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12), dark 0 4px 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.26), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4). Fluent depth 8: tooltips and small flyouts. A key and an ambient shadow; dark themes keep both, darker. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.layer, elevation.flyout, elevation.dialog) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `depth.16` (semantic shadow): `--by-depth-16`. Values: light 0 8px 16px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12), dark 0 8px 16px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.26), 0 0 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4). Fluent depth 16: flyouts: menus, popovers, select and combobox lists, toasts. A key and an ambient shadow; dark themes keep both, darker. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.layer, elevation.flyout, elevation.dialog) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `depth.28` (semantic shadow): `--by-depth-28`. Values: light 0 14px 28px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14), 0 0 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12), dark 0 14px 28px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.26), 0 0 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4). Fluent depth 28: large flyouts and teaching popups. A key and an ambient shadow; dark themes keep both, darker. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.layer, elevation.flyout, elevation.dialog) that bundles shadow, border and surface.
- `depth.64` (semantic shadow): `--by-depth-64`. Values: light 0 32px 64px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14), 0 0 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12), dark 0 32px 64px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.26), 0 0 8px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4). Fluent depth 64: dialogs and other windows above the page. A key and an ambient shadow; dark themes keep both, darker. Not on a component directly: use the elevation role (elevation.layer, elevation.flyout, elevation.dialog) that bundles shadow, border and surface.

### blur (roles)

- `blur.acrylic` (semantic dimension): `--by-blur-acrylic`. Tailwind `*-acrylic` (--blur-acrylic). Values: 30px. Blur of what shows through a translucent flyout or layer (backdrop-filter: blur(), the backdrop-blur-acrylic utility), so text on it stays legible. Not a shadow blur, and not on opaque surfaces, where it costs paint time and shows nothing.

### space (roles)

Not for the gap between components in a row or grid (use space.gap.*) or for padding inside a container (use space.inset.*). Not a fixed pixel value: the density mode changes it.

### syntax (roles)

- `syntax.keyword` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-keyword`. Tailwind `*-syntax-keyword` (--color-syntax-keyword). Values: light oklch(0.46 0.1275 305), dark oklch(0.82 0.105 305). Editor text colour for keywords: SELECT, FROM, function, return. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.
- `syntax.string` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-string`. Tailwind `*-syntax-string` (--color-syntax-string). Values: light oklch(0.46 0.119 150), dark oklch(0.82 0.098 150). Editor text colour for string and character literals. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.
- `syntax.number` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-number`. Tailwind `*-syntax-number` (--color-syntax-number). Values: light oklch(0.46 0.1139 55), dark oklch(0.82 0.112 55). Editor text colour for numeric literals. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.
- `syntax.comment` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-comment`. Tailwind `*-syntax-comment` (--color-syntax-comment). Values: light oklch(0.505 0.012 275), dark oklch(0.7825 0.0108 275). Editor text colour for comments: they recede, but stay readable. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.
- `syntax.function` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-function`. Tailwind `*-syntax-function` (--color-syntax-function). Values: light oklch(0.46 0.1445 255), dark oklch(0.82 0.0915 255). Editor text colour for function and method names, and calls. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.
- `syntax.operator` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-operator`. Tailwind `*-syntax-operator` (--color-syntax-operator). Values: light oklch(0.46 0.0102 275), dark oklch(0.82 0.0084 275). Editor text colour for operators and punctuation: = + , ;. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.
- `syntax.type` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-type`. Tailwind `*-syntax-type` (--color-syntax-type). Values: light oklch(0.46 0.0794 190), dark oklch(0.82 0.077 190). Editor text colour for type names and built-in types: INTEGER, text, string. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.
- `syntax.identifier` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-identifier`. Tailwind `*-syntax-identifier` (--color-syntax-identifier). Values: light oklch(0.22 0.0054 275), dark oklch(0.955 0.003 275). Editor text colour for table, column and variable names. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.
- `syntax.constant` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-constant`. Tailwind `*-syntax-constant` (--color-syntax-constant). Values: light oklch(0.46 0.097 75), dark oklch(0.82 0.105 75). Editor text colour for constants and special values: TRUE, NULL, CURRENT_DATE. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.
- `syntax.error` (semantic color): `--by-syntax-error`. Tailwind `*-syntax-error` (--color-syntax-error). Values: light oklch(0.46 0.17 27), dark oklch(0.82 0.101 27). Editor text colour for syntax errors and invalid tokens. Monaco gets it as a hex value in the generated theme; CodeMirror reads the variable. Not for interface text outside a code editor: use color.fg.* or text status colours.

### editor (roles)

- `editor.bg` (semantic color): `--by-editor-bg`. Tailwind `*-editor` (--color-editor). Values: light oklch(1 0 0), dark oklch(0.25 0.0108 275). Background of a code editor and of a code block. Not for the app background: use color.bg.canvas.
- `editor.fg` (semantic color): `--by-editor-fg`. Tailwind `*-editor-fg` (--color-editor-fg). Values: light oklch(0.22 0.0054 275), dark oklch(0.955 0.003 275). Default text colour inside a code editor, for text that has no syntax role. Not for syntax-highlighted tokens: use syntax.*.
- `editor.selection` (semantic color): `--by-editor-selection`. Tailwind `*-editor-selection` (--color-editor-selection). Values: light oklch(0.4592 0.3083 264.16 / 0.153), dark oklch(0.6378 0.1973 280.34 / 0.292). Background of selected text in a code editor (translucent, so the syntax colours stay readable). Not for a selected row or item: use color.interactive.selected.
- `editor.line-highlight` (semantic color): `--by-editor-line-highlight`. Tailwind `*-editor-line` (--color-editor-line). Values: light oklch(0.3396 0.1971 264.86 / 0.04), dark oklch(0.8987 0.0439 251.49 / 0.043). Background of the line the cursor is on (translucent). Not for hover: use color.interactive.hover.
- `editor.cursor` (semantic color): `--by-editor-cursor`. Tailwind `*-editor-cursor` (--color-editor-cursor). Values: light oklch(0.22 0.0054 275), dark oklch(0.955 0.003 275). The text cursor (caret) of a code editor. Not for the focus ring: use color.ring.
- `editor.gutter` (semantic color): `--by-editor-gutter`. Tailwind `*-editor-gutter` (--color-editor-gutter). Values: light oklch(0.505 0.012 275), dark oklch(0.7825 0.0108 275). Colour of the line numbers in the gutter of a code editor (text, not the gutter background, which is editor.bg). Not for other secondary text: use color.fg.muted.
- `editor.match` (semantic color): `--by-editor-match`. Tailwind `*-editor-match` (--color-editor-match). Values: light oklch(0.6325 0.1482 60.08 / 0.259), dark oklch(0.7548 0.1771 59.97 / 0.234). Background behind search matches and the bracket that pairs with the one under the cursor (translucent). Not for the selection: use editor.selection.

### grid (roles)

- `grid.header-bg` (semantic color): `--by-grid-header-bg`. Tailwind `*-grid-header` (--color-grid-header). Values: light oklch(0.955 0.0084 275), dark oklch(0.14 0.0036 275). Background of the header row of a result grid. Not for body rows: use grid.row-bg.

- `grid.row-hover` (semantic color): `--by-grid-row-hover`. Tailwind `*-grid-row-hover` (--color-grid-row-hover). - `space.*` (15 dimension): 0 px on the 4 px space scale. 0=0; 0-5=2px; 1=4px; 1-5=6px; 2=8px; 3=12px; 4=16px; 5=20px; 6=24px; 8=32px; 10=40px; 12=48px; 16=64px; 20=80px; 24=96px.
- `font.size.*` (19 dimension): The 2xs step of the legacy type scale, derived from the fontSize seed (the base step is the body size). 2xs=11px; xs=12px; sm=13px; base=14px; lg=16px; xl=18px; 2xl=20px; 3xl=24px; 4xl=30px; 100=10px; 200=12px; 300=14px; 400=16px; 500=20px; 600=24px; 700=28px; 800=32px; 900=40px; 1000=68px.
- `font.weight.*` (4 fontWeight): Font weight 400 (regular). regular=400; medium=500; semibold=600; bold=700.
- `font.leading.*` (14 number): Unitless line height 1.2, for large headings and display text. tight=1.2; snug=1.35; normal=1.5; relaxed=1.65; 100=1.4; 200=1.3333; 300=1.4286; 400=1.375; 500=1.4; 600=1.3333; 700=1.2857; 800=1.25; 900=1.3; 1000=1.3529.
- `font.tracking.*` (3 dimension): Letter spacing of -0.3 px, for large headings, where the glyphs look loose. tight=-0.3px; normal=0; wide=0.4px.
- `size.icon.*` (5 dimension): Edge of a xs icon (12 px): the size-icon-xs utility. xs=12px; sm=14px; md=16px; lg=20px; xl=24px. Tailwind `*-icon-xs` (--spacing-icon-xs), `*-icon-sm` (--spacing-icon-sm), `*-icon-md` (--spacing-icon-md), `*-icon-lg` (--spacing-icon-lg), `*-icon-xl` (--spacing-icon-xl).
- `size.*` (2 dimension): Thickness of a slider track or a thin progress bar (4 px): the h-track (w-track when vertical) utility. track=4px; field=160px. Tailwind `*-track` (--spacing-track), `*-field` (--spacing-field).
- `size.panel.*` (7 dimension): Width of a xs panel (240 px), for a tooltip's maximum width, a sidebar: the w-panel-xs and max-w-panel-xs utilities. xs=240px; sm=320px; md=448px; lg=576px; xl=768px; pane=420px; sheet=600px. Tailwind `*-panel-xs` (--spacing-panel-xs), `*-panel-sm` (--spacing-panel-sm), `*-panel-md` (--spacing-panel-md), `*-panel-lg` (--spacing-panel-lg), `*-panel-xl` (--spacing-panel-xl), `*-panel-pane` (--spacing-panel-pane), `*-panel-sheet` (--spacing-panel-sheet).
- `border.width.*` (4 dimension): A 0 px border. 0=0; 1=1px; 2=2px; 3=3px.
- `breakpoint.*` (5 dimension): Viewport width 640 px at which layouts change (the sm breakpoint), for scripts and docs that need the number. sm=640px; md=768px; lg=1024px; xl=1280px; 2xl=1536px.
- `opacity.*` (3 number): Opacity of a disabled control that is dimmed instead of recoloured. disabled=0.5; hover=0.08; overlay=0.6.
- `z.*` (8 number): Layer 0 for ordinary content. base=0; sticky=100; dropdown=200; overlay=300; modal=400; popover=500; toast=600; tooltip=700.
- `motion.duration.*` (9 duration): 0 ms, for changes that must not animate (reduced motion, drag following the pointer). instant=0; ultra-fast=50ms; faster=100ms; fast=150ms; normal=200ms; gentle=250ms; slow=300ms; slower=400ms; ultra-slow=500ms.
- `motion.easing.*` (9 cubicBezier): Fluent's accelerate-max curve, for large elements that leave fast and far (a drawer closing). accelerate-max=cubic-bezier(0.9, 0.1, 1, 0.2); accelerate-mid=cubic-bezier(1, 0, 1, 1); accelerate-min=cubic-bezier(0.8, 0, 0.78, 1); decelerate-max=cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.9, 0.2, 1); decelerate-mid=cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1); decelerate-min=cubic-bezier(0.33, 0, 0.1, 1); easy-ease-max=cubic-bezier(0.8, 0, 0.2, 1); easy-ease=cubic-bezier(0.33, 0, 0.67, 1); linear=cubic-bezier(0, 0, 1, 1). Tailwind `*-accelerate-max` (--ease-accelerate-max), `*-accelerate-mid` (--ease-accelerate-mid), `*-accelerate-min` (--ease-accelerate-min), `*-decelerate-max` (--ease-decelerate-max), `*-decelerate-mid` (--ease-decelerate-mid), `*-decelerate-min` (--ease-decelerate-min), `*-easy-ease-max` (--ease-easy-ease-max), `*-easy-ease` (--ease-easy-ease).
